title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data
title_zh: 共享几何结构：无需配对数据的跨模态对齐

paragraphs.en: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态表示能够支持零样本分类和检索，但通常需要对独立训练的模型进行对齐，而这需要大量的配对数据。 然而，柏拉图表示假设指出，在不同模态上训练的模型可能会自发地收敛到一个共享的表示几何结构中。 但这样一来，我们真的还需要配对样本来进行跨模态对齐吗？ 值得注意的是，我们发现粗粒度的跨模态对齐并不依赖配对样本。 我们的简单 Wasserstein Procrustes 方法通过粗略的几何初始化，无需观察任何配对样本，仅通过估计一个正交映射即可对齐两个互不重叠的嵌入集。 我们在多个数据集、模态和单模态模型上验证了这一点：无需配对样本即可稳定地对齐独立训练的表示，并且标准的几何对齐指标能够准确预测这种对齐是否可行。 尽管如此，我们仍然可以自然地利用配对样本带来的优势。 在极少量配对的场景下，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，并且在增加更多样本后，其性能仍能与基于配对的方法保持竞争力。 最后，我们证明了由此产生的对齐结果可以在没有配对样本的情况下实现文本到图像的生成。 这些结果表明，独立训练的模型通常共享足够的几何结构，因此即使几乎没有或完全没有配对数据，也能建立跨模态对应关系。

paragraphs.en: The discovery of the Rosetta Stone was a philology breakthrough. By having a Greek translation to a small text, the stone provided sufficient information to Champollion and Young to decipher entire ancient Egyptian scripts. Modern multimodal learning follows essentially the same principle. Models across modalities are usually connected by paired observations via image captions ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021a ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) , biological ( Xiong et al., 2023 ) , or scientific data ( Chang & Ye, 2024 ) . Example pairs act as a multimodal Rosetta Stone illustrating how one modality maps to another. This assumption underlies major paradigms: contrastive learning from image-caption pairs ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021a ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) or multimodal foundation models trained on paired data at massive scale ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Even methods designed to reduce supervision still need some known pairings as cross-modal anchors ( Norelli et al., 2023 ; Maiorca et al., 2023 ; Maniparambil et al., 2024 ; Yacobi et al., 2026 ; Gröger et al., 2026b ; Roschmann et al., 2026 ) . The prevailing view is that meaningful alignment requires at least some observed correspondences.
paragraphs.zh: 罗塞塔石碑的发现是语文学领域的一项重大突破。 由于这块石碑上包含一小段希腊文译文，它提供了足够的信息，使尚波里翁和杨能够破译完整的古埃及文字体系。 现代多模态学习本质上遵循相同的原理。 不同模态的模型通常通过图像配文（Radford et al., 2021; Jia et al., 2021a; Zhai et al., 2023）、生物学数据（Xiong et al., 2023）或科学数据（Chang & Ye, 2024）中的成对观察结果相互连接。 示例配对如同一个多模态的罗塞塔石碑，展示了不同模态之间如何相互映射。 这一假设是多种重要范式的理论基础：例如基于图像-配文对的反差学习（Radford et al., 2021; Jia et al., 2021a; Zhai et al., 2023），或在大规模配对数据上训练的多模态基础模型（Bai et al., 2025）。 即便是旨在减少监督的方法，仍然需要一些已知的配对作为跨模态的锚点（Norelli et al., 2023; Maiorca et al., 2023; Maniparambil et al., 2024; Yacobi et al., 2026; Gröger et al., 2026b; Roschmann et al., 2026）。 主流观点认为，实现有意义的对齐至少需要一些可观察到的对应关系。

sents.zh: 罗塞塔石碑的发现是语文学领域的一项重大突破。

paragraphs.en: Recent findings fragilize this view. Independently trained models often show oddly similar geometry. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) ( Huh et al., 2024 ) proposes that models spontaneously converge to a shared representation as model and dataset scale increase. While the extent of convergence is unclear ( Gröger et al., 2026a ; Koepke et al., 2026 ) , there is substantial representation agreement across modalities, mostly coarsely ( Koepke et al., 2026 ) . This extends to video ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , audio ( Ngo & Kim, 2024 ) , neuroscience ( Marcos-Manchón et al., 2026 ) , and scientific models ( Edamadaka et al., 2025 ; Li & Walsh, 2026 ) . These findings raise a fundamental question:
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究结果削弱了这一观点。 独立训练的模型常常表现出奇怪地相似的几何结构。 柏拉图式表示假设（PRH）（Huh 等人，2024）提出，随着模型和数据集规模的扩大，模型会自发地收敛到一个共享的表示。 尽管收敛的程度尚不明确（Gröger 等人，2026a；Koepke 等人，2026），但不同模态之间确实存在显著的表示一致性，且这种一致性大多较为粗略（Koepke 等人，2026）。 这一现象也延伸至视频（Zhu 等人，2026）、音频（Ngo & Kim，2024）、神经科学（Marcos-Manchón 等人，2026）以及科学模型（Edamadaka 等人，2025；Li & Walsh，2026）。 这些发现提出了一个根本性问题：

sents.en: Recent findings fragilize this view.
sents.zh: 近期的研究结果削弱了这一观点。

sents.en: Independently trained models often show oddly similar geometry.
sents.zh: 独立训练的模型常常表现出奇怪地相似的几何结构。

sents.en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) ( Huh et al., 2024 ) proposes that models spontaneously converge to a shared representation as model and dataset scale increase.
sents.zh: 柏拉图式表示假设（PRH）（Huh 等人，2024）提出，随着模型和数据集规模的扩大，模型会自发地收敛到一个共享的表示。

sents.en: While the extent of convergence is unclear ( Gröger et al., 2026a ; Koepke et al., 2026 ) , there is substantial representation agreement across modalities, mostly coarsely ( Koepke et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 尽管收敛的程度尚不明确（Gröger 等人，2026a；Koepke 等人，2026），但不同模态之间确实存在显著的表示一致性，且这种一致性大多较为粗略（Koepke 等人，2026）。

sents.en: This extends to video ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , audio ( Ngo & Kim, 2024 ) , neuroscience ( Marcos-Manchón et al., 2026 ) , and scientific models ( Edamadaka et al., 2025 ; Li & Walsh, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 这一现象也延伸至视频（Zhu 等人，2026）、音频（Ngo & Kim，2024）、神经科学（Marcos-Manchón 等人，2026）以及科学模型（Edamadaka 等人，2025；Li & Walsh，2026）。

sents.en: These findings raise a fundamental question:
sents.zh: 这些发现提出了一个根本性问题：

paragraphs.en: This question is challenging as both embedding spaces have no shared coordinates, no known sample correspondences, and potentially different numbers of samples and dimensions. Prior works ( Norelli et al., 2023 ; Maiorca et al., 2023 ; Maniparambil et al., 2024 ; Yacobi et al., 2026 ; Gröger et al., 2026b ; Roschmann et al., 2026 ) have shown that a few paired examples may suffice if the embedding geometry is exploited. Early evidence from fully unpaired methods ( Hoshen & Wolf, 2018b ; Schnaus et al., 2025 ) hints that geometric structure may recover cross-modal correspondences, but these methods have been restricted to small-scale datasets or class-level embeddings. Aligning disjoint sets when removing all paired examples remained an unsolved problem.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题具有挑战性，因为两个嵌入空间都没有共享的坐标，也没有已知的样本对应关系，并且样本数量和维度也可能不同。 先前的研究（Norelli 等人，2023；Maiorca 等人，2023；Maniparambil 等人，2024；Yacobi 等人，2026；Gröger 等人，2026b；Roschmann 等人，2026）表明，如果能利用嵌入几何结构，少量配对示例可能就足够了。 完全非配对方法（Hoshen & Wolf，2018b；Schnaus 等人，2025）的早期证据表明，几何结构或许能够恢复跨模态对应关系，但这些方法仅限于小规模数据集或类别级别的嵌入。 在移除所有配对示例的情况下，对齐互不相交集合仍然是一个未解决的问题。

sents.en: This question is challenging as both embedding spaces have no shared coordinates, no known sample correspondences, and potentially different numbers of samples and dimensions.
sents.zh: 这个问题具有挑战性，因为两个嵌入空间都没有共享的坐标，也没有已知的样本对应关系，并且样本数量和维度也可能不同。

sents.en: Prior works ( Norelli et al., 2023 ; Maiorca et al., 2023 ; Maniparambil et al., 2024 ; Yacobi et al., 2026 ; Gröger et al., 2026b ; Roschmann et al., 2026 ) have shown that a few paired examples may suffice if the embedding geometry is exploited.
sents.zh: 先前的研究（Norelli 等人，2023；Maiorca 等人，2023；Maniparambil 等人，2024；Yacobi 等人，2026；Gröger 等人，2026b；Roschmann 等人，2026）表明，如果能利用嵌入几何结构，少量配对示例可能就足够了。

sents.en: Early evidence from fully unpaired methods ( Hoshen & Wolf, 2018b ; Schnaus et al., 2025 ) hints that geometric structure may recover cross-modal correspondences, but these methods have been restricted to small-scale datasets or class-level embeddings.
sents.zh: 完全非配对方法（Hoshen & Wolf，2018b；Schnaus 等人，2025）的早期证据表明，几何结构或许能够恢复跨模态对应关系，但这些方法仅限于小规模数据集或类别级别的嵌入。

sents.en: Aligning disjoint sets when removing all paired examples remained an unsolved problem.
sents.zh: 在移除所有配对示例的情况下，对齐互不相交集合仍然是一个未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we show that such a blind cross-modal alignment is possible, at least at a coarse level. By introducing a simple alignment procedure based on Wasserstein Procrustes ( Rangarajan et al., 1997 ; Cohen & Guibas, 1999 ) , we jointly infer a correspondence between samples and an orthogonal mapping between embedding spaces. Due to non-convex ( Alvarez-Melis et al., 2019 ) optimization, random initialization is insufficient. Inspired by mini-vec2vec ( Dar, 2025 ) , we instead find a coarse correspondence by independently matching the geometric structure of the two embedding spaces and use it to initialize the joint alignment. The resulting procedure requires only the two sets of unimodal embeddings. It uses no paired examples, class labels, or shared reference points.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们证明了这种盲目的跨模态对齐是可行的，至少可以在粗略层面上实现。 通过引入一种基于 Wasserstein Procrustes（Rangarajan 等人，1997；Cohen & Guibas，1999）的简单对齐程序，我们共同推断出样本之间的对应关系以及嵌入空间之间的正交映射。 由于优化过程是非凸的（Alvarez-Melis 等人，2019），随机初始化是不够的。 受 mini-vec2vec（Dar，2025）的启发，我们转而通过独立匹配两个嵌入空间的几何结构来找到粗略的对应关系，并以此初始化联合对齐。 由此得到的程序仅需两组单模态嵌入。 它不使用任何成对示例、类别标签或共享参考点。

sents.zh: 在本文中，我们证明了这种盲目的跨模态对齐是可行的，至少可以在粗略层面上实现。

sents.en: The resulting procedure requires only the two sets of unimodal embeddings.
sents.zh: 由此得到的程序仅需两组单模态嵌入。

sents.en: It uses no paired examples, class labels, or shared reference points.

paragraphs.en: Across many datasets, vision models, and language models, we find that independently trained models can be aligned without paired data. The recovered alignment captures coarse semantic structure even when images and captions come from different datasets. In fact, our unpaired alignment quality is strongly predicted by geometric similarity between embedding spaces, measured by common scores like Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) . This provides an empirical criterion for unpaired alignment success chances. This relationship is not specific to image-text models and extends to scientific and medical domains. Our framework naturally generalizes to few paired examples, bridging the unpaired and (very) few-pair settings. With very few pairs ( ≤ 100 \leq 100 ), we substantially outperform baselines and remain competitive with more added pairs. We also demonstrate proof-of-concept text-to-image generation without image-text pairs. Together, our results suggest a different view of multimodal alignment: paired examples are not always necessary for cross-modal alignment. Independent models often already organize their embedding spaces similarly enough for shared geometry to reveal coarse correspondences. Unlike the historical one, a multi-modal Rosetta Stone might not be necessary, although having a small one can greatly refine the estimated alignment. Instead, leveraging shared geometries provides the required coarse bridge.
paragraphs.zh: 在多个数据集、视觉模型和语言模型中，我们发现独立训练的模型无需配对数据即可实现对齐。 即使图像和说明文字来自不同数据集，恢复出的对齐仍能捕捉到粗略的语义结构。 事实上，我们的无配对对齐质量可通过嵌入空间之间的几何相似性进行有效预测，这种相似性常用中心化核对齐（CKA）（Kornblith 等人，2019）等指标衡量。 这为无配对对齐能否成功提供了一个经验性标准。 这种关系并非图像-文本模型所独有，也适用于科学和医学领域。 我们的框架能自然地推广到少量配对样本的情况，从而在无配对与（极少量）配对设置之间架起桥梁。 在极少量配对样本（≤ 100）的情况下，我们的方法显著优于基线模型，并在增加更多配对样本后仍能保持竞争力。 我们还展示了无需图像-文本配对的文本到图像生成概念验证。 综合来看，我们的研究结果为多模态对齐提供了新的视角：跨模态对齐并不总是需要配对样本。 独立模型通常已以足够相似的方式组织其嵌入空间，使得共享的几何结构能够揭示粗略的对应关系。 与历史上的做法不同，或许并不需要一块“多模态罗塞塔石碑”，尽管拥有一小块这样的石碑可以极大地优化对齐估计结果。 相反，利用共享的几何结构就能提供所需的粗略连接桥梁。

sents.zh: 在多个数据集、视觉模型和语言模型中，我们发现独立训练的模型无需配对数据即可实现对齐。

sents.en: Our framework naturally generalizes to few paired examples, bridging the unpaired and (very) few-pair settings.
sents.zh: 我们的框架能自然地推广到少量配对样本的情况，从而在无配对与（极少量）配对设置之间架起桥梁。

sents.en: With very few pairs ( ≤ 100 \leq 100 ), we substantially outperform baselines and remain competitive with more added pairs.
sents.zh: 在极少量配对样本（≤ 100）的情况下，我们的方法显著优于基线模型，并在增加更多配对样本后仍能保持竞争力。

sents.en: We also demonstrate proof-of-concept text-to-image generation without image-text pairs.
sents.zh: 我们还展示了无需图像-文本配对的文本到图像生成概念验证。

sents.en: Together, our results suggest a different view of multimodal alignment: paired examples are not always necessary for cross-modal alignment.
sents.zh: 综合来看，我们的研究结果为多模态对齐提供了新的视角：跨模态对齐并不总是需要配对样本。

sents.en: Independent models often already organize their embedding spaces similarly enough for shared geometry to reveal coarse correspondences.
sents.zh: 独立模型通常已以足够相似的方式组织其嵌入空间，使得共享的几何结构能够揭示粗略的对应关系。

sents.en: Unlike the historical one, a multi-modal Rosetta Stone might not be necessary, although having a small one can greatly refine the estimated alignment.
sents.zh: 与历史上的做法不同，或许并不需要一块“多模态罗塞塔石碑”，尽管拥有一小块这样的石碑可以极大地优化对齐估计结果。

sents.en: Instead, leveraging shared geometries provides the required coarse bridge.
sents.zh: 相反，利用共享的几何结构就能提供所需的粗略连接桥梁。

paragraphs.en: Our work builds on three observations. First, independently trained embedding spaces within a modality can often be aligned without pairs via almost isometric ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) geometry. Second, independently trained models across modalities also exhibit shared geometry. Third, shared geometry has already reduced paired-data needs for cross-modal alignment. We combine these ideas in the zero-pair regime, showing that geometry alone enables coarse cross-modal alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作基于三个观察结果。 首先，同一模态中独立训练的嵌入空间通常可以通过近乎等距（Mikolov 等人，2013）的几何结构进行对齐，而无需成对数据。 其次，跨模态独立训练的模型也表现出共享的几何结构。 第三，共享的几何结构已经降低了跨模态对齐对成对数据的需求。 我们在零配对场景下整合了这些思路，并证明仅凭几何结构即可实现粗略的跨模态对齐。

sents.en: Our work builds on three observations.

sents.en: First, independently trained embedding spaces within a modality can often be aligned without pairs via almost isometric ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) geometry.

sents.en: We combine these ideas in the zero-pair regime, showing that geometry alone enables coarse cross-modal alignment.

paragraphs.en: Unpaired alignment within a modality. Unpaired alignment was first studied in unsupervised translation, for aligning across languages independently trained word embedding spaces. Two main approaches have emerged. Adversarial methods ( Conneau et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2017a ; Zhang et al., 2017b ; Xu et al., 2018 ; Mohiuddin & Joty, 2019 ) learn a transformation such that a discriminator cannot distinguish mapped source from target embeddings. Optimization-based methods instead explicitly search for a correspondence between the samples. This leads to Wasserstein Procrustes ( Artetxe et al., 2018 ; Hoshen & Wolf, 2018a ; Grave et al., 2019 ; Aboagye et al., 2022 ; Even et al., 2024 ) , which jointly optimizes the correspondence and an orthogonal transformation, or to Gromov-Wasserstein ( Alvarez-Melis & Jaakkola, 2018 ; Marchisio et al., 2022 ) formulations that seek correspondences preserving pairwise distances. These ideas have since been extended beyond word embeddings to whole-text representations, including the adversarial vec2vec ( Jha et al., 2026 ) and optimization-based mini-vec2vec ( Dar, 2025 ) methods, as well as to applications in bioinformatics ( Demetci et al., 2022 ; Baker et al., 2026 ) and neuroscience ( Thual et al., 2022 ; Marcos-Manchón et al., 2026 ) . While these methods demonstrate that shared geometry can enable unpaired alignment, they consider representations within the same modality. We ask whether the same principle can bridge different modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 模态内部的非配对对齐。 非配对对齐最初在无监督翻译中被研究，用于对齐跨语言独立训练的词嵌入空间。 目前出现了两种主要方法。 对抗性方法（Conneau et al., 2018；Zhang et al., 2017a；Zhang et al., 2017b；Xu et al., 2018；Mohiuddin & Joty, 2019）学习一种变换，使得判别器无法区分映射后的源语言嵌入与目标语言嵌入。 基于优化的方法则明确地在样本之间搜索对应关系。 这引出了瓦瑟斯坦普罗克里斯特斯方法（Artetxe et al., 2018；Hoshen & Wolf, 2018a；Grave et al., 2019；Aboagye et al., 2022；Even et al., 2024），该方法联合优化对应关系和一个正交变换，或者引出了格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦（Alvarez-Melis & Jaakkola, 2018；Marchisio et al., 2022）公式，该公式寻求能够保留成对距离的对应关系。 此后，这些思想已从词嵌入扩展到整个文本表示，包括对抗性的 vec2vec（Jha et al., 2026）和基于优化的 mini-vec2vec（Dar, 2025）方法，也扩展到了生物信息学（Demetci et al., 2022；Baker et al., 2026）和神经科学（Thual et al., 2022；Marcos-Manchón et al., 2026）的应用领域。 尽管这些方法表明共享的几何结构可以实现非配对对齐，但它们考虑的是同一模态内的表示。 我们想知道，同样的原则是否可以跨越不同的模态。

paragraphs.en: Shared geometry across modalities. Independently trained models across modalities have also been shown to converge toward similar representations. At the unit level, “Rosetta Neurons” ( Dravid et al., 2023 ) identified neurons encoding shared concepts in independently trained vision models. At the representation level, different modality representations can be connected via simple linear or orthogonal transformations ( Merullo et al., 2023 ; Koh et al., 2023 ; Maiorca et al., 2023 ; Gupta et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Relative representations ( Moschella et al., 2023 ) go further by expressing samples through similarities to paired reference examples, using these shared relationships to place different modalities in a common space. Such reference examples form a multimodal “Rosetta Stone” ( Norelli et al., 2023 ) . The Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Huh et al., 2024 ) provides a broader framework for these observations, proposing that representations from different models converge toward a shared geometry as model and training data scale increase. Across vision and language models, empirical studies consistently find shared geometric structure, with alignment increasing particularly in coarse neighborhood structure ( Gröger et al., 2026a ; Koepke et al., 2026 ) . Similar alignment has also been observed across audio-language ( Ngo & Kim, 2024 ) , video-language ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and scientific models ( Edamadaka et al., 2025 ; Li & Walsh, 2026 ) . Prior work measures this shared structure on paired representations. We use it to map between embedding spaces without paired data, showing a strong Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Jha et al., 2026 ) across modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模态的共享几何结构。 研究还表明，跨模态独立训练的模型会收敛到相似的表示。 在单元层面，“罗塞塔神经元”（Dravid 等，2023）识别出在独立训练的视觉模型中编码共享概念的神经元。 在表示层面，不同模态的表示可以通过简单的线性或正交变换相互连接（Merullo 等，2023；Koh 等，2023；Maiorca 等，2023；Gupta 等，2026；Li 等，2024）。 相对表示（Moschella 等，2023）更进一步，通过样本与成对参考示例的相似性来表达样本，并利用这些共享关系将不同模态置于一个共同空间中。 这类参考示例构成了一个多模态的“罗塞塔石碑”（Norelli 等，2023）。 柏拉图表示假说（Huh 等，2024）为这些观察结果提供了更广泛的框架，该假说提出，随着模型和训练数据规模的扩大，不同模型的表示会收敛到一个共享的几何结构。 在视觉和语言模型中，经验研究一致发现了共享的几何结构，尤其是在粗粒度邻域结构中，这种对齐现象尤为显著（Gröger 等，2026a；Koepke 等，2026）。 类似的对齐现象也出现在音频-语言（Ngo & Kim，2024）、视频-语言（Zhu 等，2026）以及科学模型（Edamadaka 等，2025；Li & Walsh，2026）中。 先前的工作是在成对表示上测量这种共享结构。 我们利用它在没有成对数据的情况下实现嵌入空间之间的映射，并展示了跨模态的强柏拉图表示假说（Jha 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Cross-modal alignment with few pairs. This shared geometry has been increasingly used to reduce the paired-data requirement for cross-modal alignment. Early contrastive works ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021a ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) learn aligned representations directly from hundreds of millions to billions of paired examples. However, much of this supervision can be replaced by strong pretrained unimodal representations. LiT ( Zhai et al., 2022 ) uses a frozen vision encoder to reduce the amount of paired data substantially. More explicitly, ASIF ( Norelli et al., 2023 ) directly uses relative representations ( Moschella et al., 2023 ) as a shared coordinate system between modalities and STRUCTURE ( Gröger et al., 2026b ) regularizes the aligned space to preserve geometric structure. Further methods use linear transformations ( Maiorca et al., 2023 ) , CKA ( Maniparambil et al., 2024 ) , spectral representations ( Yacobi et al., 2026 ) , or optimal transport ( Roschmann et al., 2026 ) to reach the few-pair regime. These methods demonstrate that paired data can primarily serve to establish a connection between embedding spaces whose internal geometry is already informative.
paragraphs.zh: 使用少量样本对进行跨模态对齐。 这种共享的几何结构已被越来越多地用于减少跨模态对齐所需的配对数据量。 早期的对比学习研究（Radford 等人，2021；Jia 等人，2021a；Zhai 等人，2023）直接从数亿到数十亿的配对样本中学习对齐后的表示。 然而，其中大部分监督信息可以通过强大的预训练单模态表示来替代。 LiT（Zhai 等人，2022）使用一个冻结的视觉编码器，从而大幅减少了所需配对数据的量。 更具体地说，ASIF（Norelli 等人，2023）直接将相对表示（Moschella 等人，2023）用作不同模态之间的共享坐标系，而 STRUCTURE（Gröger 等人，2026b）则对对齐空间进行正则化以保留几何结构。 其他方法则使用线性变换（Maiorca 等人，2023）、CKA（Maniparambil 等人，2024）、谱表示（Yacobi 等人，2026）或最优传输（Roschmann 等人，2026）来实现少量样本对齐。 这些方法表明，配对数据的主要作用是在其内部几何结构已具备信息量的嵌入空间之间建立连接。

paragraphs.en: Rare works have studied the fully unpaired cross-modal setting, but for more restricted assumptions. Hoshen & Wolf (2018b) align supervised representations with an adversarial CycleGAN ( Zhu et al., 2017 ) , and Schnaus et al. (2025) align class-aggregated embeddings using pairwise distances. These results suggest cross-modal geometry information may recover matchings without examples, but they are limited to small-scale settings or class-aggregated embeddings. In contrast, we tackle disjoint embedding sets from independent models and use no paired examples, class labels, or shared reference points. We show that shared geometry alone can recover a coarse cross-modal alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 鲜有研究探讨完全无配对的跨模态设置，但通常基于更受限的假设。 Hoshen & Wolf (2018b) 通过对抗性 CycleGAN（Zhu et al., 2017）对齐监督表示，而 Schnaus et al. (2025) 则利用成对距离对齐类别聚合后的嵌入。 这些结果表明，跨模态几何信息或许能在无示例的情况下恢复匹配关系，但相关研究仅限于小规模设置或类别聚合嵌入。 相比之下，我们处理来自独立模型的不相交嵌入集，且不使用任何配对示例、类别标签或共享参考点。 我们证明，仅凭共享的几何信息即可恢复粗略的跨模态对齐。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to see if shared geometry alone is sufficient to align independently trained embedding spaces across modalities. paragraphs.en: Few-pair extension. We can naturally incorporate a few paired examples. Known pairs contribute to the cluster-matching objective during initialization as a linear term ( Line 7 ) and to the Procrustes update during refinement ( Line 5 and Line 9 ). We weigh the paired examples in the Procrustes step such that their total contribution is comparable to that of the pseudo-pairs obtained from the unpaired data. Thus, the same algorithm continuously interpolates between the fully unpaired and few-pair settings. Appendix A provides derivations, complexity, sensitivity, and implementation details. The ablations show that the quality of the QAP solution matters most and that our method is stable with respect to all four of its hyperparameters, with larger values generally giving a better alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 少量配对扩展。 我们可以自然地融入少量配对示例。 在初始化阶段，已知配对以线性项的形式（第 7 行）为聚类匹配目标做出贡献；在优化阶段，它们也为 Procrustes 更新做出贡献（第 5 行和第 9 行）。 我们在 Procrustes 步骤中对配对示例进行加权，使其总贡献与从非配对数据中获得的伪配对的贡献相当。 因此，同一算法可以在完全无配对和少量配对的设置之间持续插值。 附录 A 提供了推导过程、复杂度分析、敏感度分析以及实现细节。 消融实验表明，QAP 解的质量最为关键，并且我们的方法对所有四个超参数都表现出稳定性，其中较大的值通常能带来更好的对齐效果。

sents.en: The ablations show that the quality of the QAP solution matters most and that our method is stable with respect to all four of its hyperparameters, with larger values generally giving a better alignment.
sents.zh: 消融实验表明，QAP 解的质量最为关键，并且我们的方法对所有四个超参数都表现出稳定性，其中较大的值通常能带来更好的对齐效果。

paragraphs.en: Can independently trained modalities be aligned without pairs? Across 7 vision, 3 language models, and 4 datasets, our method consistently recovers coarse cross-modal structure, including when the two modalities are drawn from different datasets. The quality of the alignment depends strongly on the shared geometry that can be measured with common metrics ( Sec. 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 独立训练的模态能否在没有配对数据的情况下实现对齐？ 在 7 个视觉模型、3 个语言模型和 4 个数据集的测试中，我们的方法始终能够恢复粗粒度的跨模态结构，即使两种模态来自不同的数据集。 对齐的质量在很大程度上取决于可以通过通用指标测量的共享几何特征（第 4.1 节）。

sents.en: Can independently trained modalities be aligned without pairs?

paragraphs.en: Does our approach generalize to less common modalities for alignment? Our simple aligner remains competitive with domain-specific methods on established unpaired benchmarks ( Sec. 4.2 ). It successfully aligns a broad range of previously unexplored modality pairs when their embedding geometries are sufficiently similar ( Sec. 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法能否推广到对齐领域较少见的模态？ 在已有的无配对基准测试中，我们简单的对齐器与领域特定方法相比仍具有竞争力（第 4.2 节）。 当它们的嵌入几何结构足够相似时，该方法能够成功对齐一系列此前未被探索的模态对（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: What is the additional benefit of few pairs? Combining our geometric initialization with very few pairs substantially improves sample efficiency and outperforms existing few-pair methods by large margins ( Sec. 4.4 ). We visualize the resulting alignment through cross-modal retrieval, PCA projections, and text-to-image generation ( Sec. 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 使用少量配对能带来什么额外好处？ 将我们的几何初始化方法与极少量的配对相结合，能够显著提升样本效率，并以较大优势超越现有的少量配对方法（第 4.4 节）。 我们通过跨模态检索、PCA 投影和文本到图像生成来可视化最终的对齐结果（第 4.5 节）。

sents.en: What is the additional benefit of few pairs?

paragraphs.en: Experimental setup. We measure cross-modal correspondence using Fraction of Samples Closer Than the True Match (FOSCTTM; Liu et al. (2019) ). This is the average rank normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , where 0.5 0.5 indicates random matching and 0 0 perfect alignment, independent of batch size. We also evaluate zero-shot classification by mapping image embeddings to the language space and selecting the closest class prompt. We report results on 5 random seeds and report mean and standard deviation for every metric. The aligner is fitted exclusively on the disjoint unimodal embeddings, and the classification datasets are used only for evaluation, with no validation-based model selection. The same hyperparameters are used for all experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 我们使用“比真实匹配更近的样本比例”（FOSCTTM；Liu 等人（2019））来衡量跨模态对应关系。 这是经过归一化到 [0, 1] 的平均排名，其中 0.5 表示随机匹配，而 0 表示完美对齐，且与批量大小无关。 我们还通过将图像嵌入映射到语言空间并选择最近的类别提示来评估零样本分类。 我们在 5 个随机种子上报告结果，并为每个指标提供均值和标准差。 对齐器仅基于互不相关的单模态嵌入进行训练，而分类数据集仅用于评估，不涉及基于验证集的选择模型过程。 所有实验均使用相同的超参数。

paragraphs.en: We first investigate unpaired alignment of independently trained vision and languages models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先研究独立训练的视觉模型和语言模型的无配对对齐。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate 7 vision and 3 language models on MS COCO ( Chen et al., 2015 ) and 3 detailed captioning datasets: Stanford Paragraph Captions (SPC) ( Krause et al., 2017 ) , DCI ( Urbanek et al., 2024 ) , and DOCCI ( Onoe et al., 2024 ) . Baselines are vec2vec ( Jha et al., 2026 ) and mini-vec2vec ( Dar, 2025 ) , which are adversarial and optimization-based methods for unpaired alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们在 MS COCO（Chen 等人，2015）以及 3 个详细描述生成数据集上评估了 7 个视觉模型和 3 个语言模型：Stanford Paragraph Captions（SPC）（Krause 等人，2017）、DCI（Urbanek 等人，2024）和 DOCCI（Onoe 等人，2024）。 基线方法包括 vec2vec（Jha 等人，2026）和 mini-vec2vec（Dar，2025），它们是用于无配对对齐的对抗性方法和基于优化的方法。

sents.en: Setup.
sents.zh: 设置。

sents.en: We evaluate 7 vision and 3 language models on MS COCO ( Chen et al., 2015 ) and 3 detailed captioning datasets: Stanford Paragraph Captions (SPC) ( Krause et al., 2017 ) , DCI ( Urbanek et al., 2024 ) , and DOCCI ( Onoe et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 我们在 MS COCO（Chen 等人，2015）以及 3 个详细描述生成数据集上评估了 7 个视觉模型和 3 个语言模型：Stanford Paragraph Captions（SPC）（Krause 等人，2017）、DCI（Urbanek 等人，2024）和 DOCCI（Onoe 等人，2024）。

sents.en: Baselines are vec2vec ( Jha et al., 2026 ) and mini-vec2vec ( Dar, 2025 ) , which are adversarial and optimization-based methods for unpaired alignment.
sents.zh: 基线方法包括 vec2vec（Jha 等人，2026）和 mini-vec2vec（Dar，2025），它们是用于无配对对齐的对抗性方法和基于优化的方法。

paragraphs.en: Results. Fig. 3 shows the results on MS COCO, those on DCI, DOCCI, and SPC are in Sec. C.1 . We see in Fig. 3(a) that vec2vec is generally close to random matching, while mini-vec2vec already recovers substantial cross-modal structure. Our method outperforms mini-vec2vec on 17 of 21 vision-language model pairs, with an average FOSCTTM of 0.154 0.154 compared with 0.223 0.223 . For reference, CLIP ViT-L/14, trained on 400M paired image-text examples, achieves 0.0006 0.0006 . Thus, our method does not recover the exact sample-wise correspondence, but it does recover substantial coarse cross-modal structure.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 图3展示了在MS COCO上的结果，而在DCI、DOCCI和SPC上的结果见C.1节。 从图3(a)中可以看出，vec2vec的结果通常接近随机匹配，而mini-vec2vec已经恢复了相当程度的跨模态结构。 我们的方法在21个视觉-语言模型组合中的17个上优于mini-vec2vec，其平均FOSCTTM为0.154（对比之下为0.223）。 作为参考，在4亿个成对图像-文本示例上训练的CLIP ViT-L/14实现的FOSCTTM为0.0006。 因此，我们的方法并未恢复精确的样本级对应关系，但确实恢复了相当程度的粗略跨模态结构。

sents.en: Results.
sents.zh: 结果。

paragraphs.en: This coarse alignment is sufficient to transfer semantic information across modalities ( cf . Fig. 3(b) ). Without using any classification data during alignment, our method achieves average zero-shot accuracies of 47.4 % 47.4\% on CIFAR-10 (Top-1), 30.1 % 30.1\% on CIFAR-100 (Top-5), and 26.5 % 26.5\% on ImageNet-100 (Top-5). On the model combination from Schnaus et al. (2025) , which is optimized directly on CIFAR-10, our method nearly doubles the Top-1 accuracy from 37.3 % 37.3\% to 69.1 % 69.1\% . On the detailed captioning datasets, we observe the same overall behavior, although generative token pooling ( Wang et al., 2026 ) performs substantially worse. We investigate this difference in Appx. D .
paragraphs.zh: 这种粗略的对齐足以在跨模态间传递语义信息（参见图3(b)）。在对齐过程中未使用任何分类数据，我们的方法在CIFAR-10上实现了47.4%（Top-1）的平均零样本准确率，在CIFAR-100上为30.1%（Top-5），在ImageNet-100上为26.5%（Top-5）。在Schnaus等人（2025年）提出的、直接在CIFAR-10上优化的模型组合中，我们的方法将Top-1准确率从37.3%几乎提升了一倍，达到69.1%。在详细的图像描述数据集上，我们观察到了相同的大致表现，尽管生成式词元池化（Wang等人，2026年）的性能明显更差。我们在附录D中探讨了这种差异。

paragraphs.en: So far, both modalities come from the same multimodal dataset. Yet our method does not need this assumption. To test this, we align MS COCO images with SPC captions, so that no ground-truth pairing exists between both datasets. Most model pairs remain similarly alignable ( cf . Fig. 3(a) , ours † ), with an average FOSCTTM of 0.236 0.236 compared with 0.154 0.154 when both modalities are drawn from MS COCO. Of note, the small degradation mainly comes from the combination of SPC and generative token pooling which is similar in the single dataset experiment ( cf . Fig. 10 ). This shows that our method does not rely on recovering a hidden pairing from two views of the same dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，两种模态都来自同一个多模态数据集。然而，我们的方法并不依赖这一假设。为了验证这一点，我们将 MS COCO 图像与 SPC 标题进行对齐，使得两个数据集之间不存在任何真实标签配对。大多数模型对仍然可以类似地实现对齐（参见图 3(a)，我们的方法 †），其平均 FOSCTTM 为 0.236 0.236，而当两种模态均取自 MS COCO 时，该值为 0.154 0.154。值得注意的是，这种轻微的性能下降主要源于 SPC 与生成式标记池化的结合，这与单数据集实验中的情况类似（参见图 10）。这表明我们的方法并不依赖于从同一数据集的两个视图恢复隐藏的对配关系。

paragraphs.en: Regarding unpaired alignment success, all tested geometry scores, including centered kernel alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) in Fig. 3(c) and others in Fig. 14 , strongly correlate with alignment quality given by FOSCTTM. Models with more similar neighborhood and distance structure are consistently easier to align, while we naturally fail to align geometrically inconsistent models.
paragraphs.zh: 关于无配对对齐的成功率，所有测试的几何分数（包括图 3(c) 中的中心化核对齐 (CKA)（Kornblith 等人，2019）以及图 14 中的其他分数）都与 FOSCTTM 提供的对齐质量高度相关。 邻域和距离结构越相似的模型，通常越容易实现对齐；而对于几何结构不一致的模型，我们自然无法完成对齐。

sents.en: Regarding unpaired alignment success, all tested geometry scores, including centered kernel alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) in Fig. 3(c) and others in Fig. 14 , strongly correlate with alignment quality given by FOSCTTM.
sents.zh: 关于无配对对齐的成功率，所有测试的几何分数（包括图 3(c) 中的中心化核对齐 (CKA)（Kornblith 等人，2019）以及图 14 中的其他分数）都与 FOSCTTM 提供的对齐质量高度相关。

sents.en: Models with more similar neighborhood and distance structure are consistently easier to align, while we naturally fail to align geometrically inconsistent models.
sents.zh: 邻域和距离结构越相似的模型，通常越容易实现对齐；而对于几何结构不一致的模型，我们自然无法完成对齐。

paragraphs.en: On vision-text, our method can align without paired data. We now study how we align non vision-text problems where specialized methods have been designed for the target domain.
paragraphs.zh: 在视觉-文本任务中，我们的方法无需配对数据即可实现对齐。 我们现在研究如何对非视觉-文本问题实现对齐，这些问题已有针对目标领域的专门方法。

sents.en: On vision-text, our method can align without paired data.
sents.zh: 在视觉-文本任务中，我们的方法无需配对数据即可实现对齐。

sents.en: We now study how we align non vision-text problems where specialized methods have been designed for the target domain.
sents.zh: 我们现在研究如何对非视觉-文本问题实现对齐，这些问题已有针对目标领域的专门方法。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate language alignment on NQ ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) against vec2vec ( Jha et al., 2026 ) and mini-vec2vec ( Dar, 2025 ) , RNA-to-ATAC alignment on PBMC ( 10x Genomics, 2021 ) against SCOT+ ( Baker et al., 2026 ) , and cross-subject fMRI alignment on NSD ( Allen et al., 2022 ) against Platonic Brain ( Marcos-Manchón et al., 2026 ) . Unlike the Platonic Brain benchmark, we report average rather than best performance, since without supervision one cannot select the best-performing seed. Additional per-pair results are given in Sec. C.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们在 NQ（Kwiatkowski 等人，2019）上评估语言对齐，并与 vec2vec（Jha 等人，2026）和 mini-vec2vec（Dar，2025）进行比较；在 PBMC（10x Genomics，2021）上评估 RNA-to-ATAC 对齐，并与 SCOT+（Baker 等人，2026）进行比较；以及在 NSD（Allen 等人，2022）上评估跨受试者 fMRI 对齐，并与 Platonic Brain（Marcos-Manchón 等人，2026）进行比较。 与 Platonic Brain 基准不同，我们报告的是平均性能而非最佳性能，因为在没有监督的情况下，无法选择性能最佳的种子。 额外的逐对结果见第 C.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Results. Our method is competitive with mini-vec2vec on NQ and achieves lower mean FOSCTTM than the specialized baselines on both PBMC ( 0.089 0.089 compared to 0.121 0.121 for SCOT+) and NSD fMRI ( 0.033 0.033 compared to 0.035 0.035 for Platonic Brain), cf . Fig. 4 . Thus, our simple geometry-based aligner transfers across language, biology, and neuroscience without task-specific adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 我们的方法与 mini-vec2vec 在 NQ 上的表现具有竞争力，并且在 PBMC（0.089 与 SCOT+ 的 0.121 相比）和 NSD fMRI（0.033 与 Platonic Brain 的 0.035 相比）上均实现了更低的平均 FOSCTTM，参见图 4。 因此，我们基于几何学的简单对齐器无需针对特定任务进行适配，即可跨语言、生物学和神经科学领域迁移应用。

sents.en: Results.
sents.zh: 结果。

sents.en: Our method is competitive with mini-vec2vec on NQ and achieves lower mean FOSCTTM than the specialized baselines on both PBMC ( 0.089 0.089 compared to 0.121 0.121 for SCOT+) and NSD fMRI ( 0.033 0.033 compared to 0.035 0.035 for Platonic Brain), cf . Fig. 4 .
sents.zh: 我们的方法与 mini-vec2vec 在 NQ 上的表现具有竞争力，并且在 PBMC（0.089 与 SCOT+ 的 0.121 相比）和 NSD fMRI（0.033 与 Platonic Brain 的 0.035 相比）上均实现了更低的平均 FOSCTTM，参见图 4。

sents.en: Thus, our simple geometry-based aligner transfers across language, biology, and neuroscience without task-specific adaptation.
sents.zh: 因此，我们基于几何学的简单对齐器无需针对特定任务进行适配，即可跨语言、生物学和神经科学领域迁移应用。

paragraphs.en: Here, we study whether shared geometry can identify new settings in which unpaired alignment is likely to work, including settings without established alignment baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们研究共享几何结构是否能够识别出新的场景，在这些场景中，无配对的对齐方法很可能有效，包括那些尚未建立对齐基准的场景。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We collect independently trained models from medicine, biology, chemistry, materials science, astronomy, neuroscience, and language. For each modality pair, we compare CKA geometric similarity with our aligner’s FOSCTTM. Full modality pairs and results are provided in Sec. C.4 .

paragraphs.en: Results. Figure 5 shows alignment quality versus the number of paired examples. We outperform all baselines at all budgets, with largest gains in the low-pair regime: with up to 20 20 pairs, our FOSCTTM is 14 × 14\times to 28 × 28\times lower than the strongest baseline’s. The gap remains 5.4 × 5.4\times at 50 50 pairs and 3.2 × 3.2\times at 100 100 , while the orthogonal map nearly catches up only at 1,000 1{,}000 . Remarkably, baselines matching our zero-pair FOSCTTM need 100 100 to 500 500 pairs to do so, and SUE never does. The advantage is even stronger downstream: our zero-pair model reaches 79.6 % 79.6\% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10, a level only STRUCTURE and orthogonal map ever reach, and only with 500 500 pairs. Conversely, we only need 20 20 pairs to match or outperform five of seven baselines given 1,000 1{,}000 pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 图 5 展示了对齐质量与配对示例数量之间的关系。 在所有预算下，我们的性能均优于所有基线模型，其中在低配对场景下的提升最为显著：当配对数量最多为 20 对时，我们的 FOSCTTM 比最强基线模型低 14 倍至 28 倍。 在 50 对时，这一差距仍为 5.4 倍；在 100 对时则为 3.2 倍，而正交映射仅在 1,000 对时才几乎追平。 值得注意的是，要与我们的零配对 FOSCTTM 相匹配，基线模型需要 100 到 500 对示例，而 SUE 则始终无法做到这一点。 这种优势在下游任务中更为显著：我们的零配对模型在 CIFAR-10 数据集上达到了 79.6% 的 top-1 准确率，这一水平只有 STRUCTURE 和正交映射模型能达到，且也需要 500 对示例才能实现。 相反，在给定 1,000 对示例的情况下，我们仅需 20 对即可与七个基线模型中的五个模型表现相当或更优。

paragraphs.en: We here visualize our coarse correspondence through four different experiments: text-to-image retrieval, image-to-text retrieval, PCA projection of the aligned space, and text-to-image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过以下四种不同的实验来展示我们的大致对应关系：文本到图像的检索、图像到文本的检索、对齐空间的PCA投影，以及文本到图像的生成功能。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We use DINOv2 ViT-B/14 and all-mpnet-base-v2 for all four experiments. For the first three experiments, we show the results when using MS COCO images and SPC captions. Retrieval and PCA projections are done on the held-out MS COCO validation split. For text-to-image generation, we fit the aligner on disjoint MS COCO images and captions, using 0 to 100 paired examples. We then train a small RAE diffusion model ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) exclusively on ImageNet-1K images ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) , conditioned on mean-pooled DINOv2 embeddings. At inference, captions are mapped to the image embedding space with our aligner, which condition the visual generator. Thus, paired data enters the pipeline only through the cross-modal aligner. The goal is not to build a competitive text-to-image system, but to view directly our cross-modal alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们在所有四个实验中均使用 DINOv2 ViT-B/14 和 all-mpnet-base-v2。 对于前三个实验，我们展示了使用 MS COCO 图像和 SPC 标题时的结果。 检索和 PCA 投影均在预留的 MS COCO 验证集上进行。 对于文本到图像生成，我们在不重叠的 MS COCO 图像和标题上训练对齐器，并使用 0 到 100 对配对示例。 然后，我们专门在 ImageNet-1K 图像（Russakovsky et al., 2015）上训练一个小型 RAE 扩散模型（Zheng et al., 2026），并以均值池化的 DINOv2 嵌入作为条件。 在推理阶段，标题通过我们的对齐器映射到图像嵌入空间，从而为视觉生成器提供条件。 因此，配对数据仅通过跨模态对齐器进入流程。 我们的目标不是构建一个具有竞争力的文本到图像系统，而是直接观察我们的跨模态对齐效果。

sents.zh: 设置。

sents.en: We then train a small RAE diffusion model ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) exclusively on ImageNet-1K images ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) , conditioned on mean-pooled DINOv2 embeddings.
sents.zh: 然后，我们专门在 ImageNet-1K 图像（Russakovsky et al., 2015）上训练一个小型 RAE 扩散模型（Zheng et al., 2026），并以均值池化的 DINOv2 嵌入作为条件。

paragraphs.en: Results. Results are in Fig. 6 . Both retrieval experiments show that coarse semantic properties, such as scene type and broad object category, are captured by the mapping. The point clouds colored by MS COCO superclasses further emphasize the coarse alignment. Though not every image is mapped exactly to its corresponding caption, categories are correctly mapped. We show similar plots for three other modalities with varying alignment quality in Fig. 19 . Our aligner can be successfully combined with a generative model to enable a full mapping from captions to images, with reasonable quality in the unpaired setting, albeit with often missing fine details. Adding a few pairs sharpens individual objects and scene attributes. We evaluate the generated images quantitatively and compare our aligner to a linear aligner, also with the Contriever model ( Izacard et al., 2022 ) in Sec. C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 结果。结果见第 6 图。 两项检索实验均表明，映射过程能够捕捉到场景类型和宽泛物体类别等粗粒度语义属性。 通过 MS COCO 超级类别着色的点云进一步凸显了这种粗粒度对齐效果。 尽管并非每张图像都能精确映射到其对应的图像描述，但各类别均得到了正确映射。 我们在第 19 图中展示了另外三种模态在质量各异的对齐情况下的类似图表。 我们的对齐器能够成功与生成模型结合，从而实现从图像描述到图像的完整映射，在未配对设置下也能达到合理的生成质量，尽管精细细节常常缺失。 添加少量配对样本可提升单个物体和场景属性的清晰度。 我们在第 C.2 节中对生成的图像进行了定量评估，并将我们的对齐器与线性对齐器（同样结合 Contriever 模型（Izacard 等，2022））进行了比较。

sents.en: We evaluate the generated images quantitatively and compare our aligner to a linear aligner, also with the Contriever model ( Izacard et al., 2022 ) in Sec. C.2 .
sents.zh: 我们在第 C.2 节中对生成的图像进行了定量评估，并将我们的对齐器与线性对齐器（同样结合 Contriever 模型（Izacard 等，2022））进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: We have shown that shared embedding geometrical information often suffices for cross-modal alignment. Yet, important conditions for success unavoidably remain. We discuss three of them here.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经证明，共享嵌入的几何信息通常足以实现跨模态对齐。 然而，成功所必需的重要条件不可避免地仍然存在。 我们将在这里讨论其中三个条件。

sents.en: We have shown that shared embedding geometrical information often suffices for cross-modal alignment.
sents.zh: 我们已经证明，共享嵌入的几何信息通常足以实现跨模态对齐。

sents.en: Yet, important conditions for success unavoidably remain.
sents.zh: 然而，成功所必需的重要条件不可避免地仍然存在。

sents.en: We discuss three of them here.
sents.zh: 我们将在这里讨论其中三个条件。

paragraphs.en: What enables unpaired cross-modal alignment? Related semantics alone seem insufficient: both embedding spaces must also organize them in a similar geometric structure, as supported by our experiments, where CKA strongly predict our aligner’s performance. Models with more similar geometry are consistently better aligned. This relationship holds experimentally beyond vision and language, suggesting that the role of shared geometry is not specific to a particular pair of modalities. Thus, geometric similarity explains why unpaired alignment succeeds. This also highlights an important limitation. Currently, we cannot reliably determine from unpaired data alone whether two spaces are sufficiently similar to be aligned, as usual alignment metrics need matching samples. Developing fully unsupervised alignment prediction scores remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 是什么使得无配对的跨模态对齐成为可能？ 仅靠相关的语义似乎并不足够：两个嵌入空间还必须以相似的几何结构来组织这些语义，我们的实验也支持这一点，其中 CKA 能够强有力地预测我们对齐器的性能。 具有更相似几何结构的模型在一致性上表现更好。 实验表明，这种关系不仅适用于视觉和语言领域，还延伸至其他领域，这说明共享几何结构的作用并非特定于某一对模态。 因此，几何相似性解释了无配对对齐为何能够成功。 这也凸显了一个重要的局限性。 目前，仅凭无配对数据，我们还无法可靠地判断两个空间是否足够相似以实现对齐，因为常规的对齐指标需要匹配样本。 开发完全无监督的对齐预测评分仍然是一个未解决的问题。

sents.en: What enables unpaired cross-modal alignment?
sents.zh: 是什么使得无配对的跨模态对齐成为可能？

sents.en: Related semantics alone seem insufficient: both embedding spaces must also organize them in a similar geometric structure, as supported by our experiments, where CKA strongly predict our aligner’s performance.

sents.zh: 具有更相似几何结构的模型在一致性上表现更好。

sents.en: This relationship holds experimentally beyond vision and language, suggesting that the role of shared geometry is not specific to a particular pair of modalities.
sents.zh: 实验表明，这种关系不仅适用于视觉和语言领域，还延伸至其他领域，这说明共享几何结构的作用并非特定于某一对模态。

sents.en: Thus, geometric similarity explains why unpaired alignment succeeds.
sents.zh: 因此，几何相似性解释了无配对对齐为何能够成功。

sents.en: This also highlights an important limitation.
sents.zh: 这也凸显了一个重要的局限性。

sents.en: Currently, we cannot reliably determine from unpaired data alone whether two spaces are sufficiently similar to be aligned, as usual alignment metrics need matching samples.
sents.zh: 目前，仅凭无配对数据，我们还无法可靠地判断两个空间是否足够相似以实现对齐，因为常规的对齐指标需要匹配样本。

sents.en: Developing fully unsupervised alignment prediction scores remains an open problem.
sents.zh: 开发完全无监督的对齐预测评分仍然是一个未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Why is the recovered alignment mostly coarse? The recovered alignment is often substantially better at matching coarse semantic structure than fine-grained details. This is consistent with the observation that modalities share information about the underlying world while also encoding modality-specific information ( Koepke et al., 2026 ) . Our analysis of local versus coarse geometric alignment in Appx. E supports this view: coarse clusters are more consistently aligned than local neighborhoods. Thus, our aligner can recover shared semantic structure without necessarily recovering modality-specific details or exact sample-wise correspondences.
paragraphs.zh: 为何恢复出的对齐大多是粗略的？恢复出的对齐通常在匹配粗略语义结构方面，比匹配精细细节要好得多。这与以下观察一致：不同模态既共享关于底层世界的信息，也编码了模态特定的信息（Koepke 等，2026）。我们在附录 E 中对局部与粗略几何对齐的分析支持这一观点：粗略聚类的一致性比对齐局部邻域更高。因此，我们的对齐器能够恢复共享的语义结构，但并不一定需要恢复模态特定的细节或精确的样本级对应关系。

paragraphs.en: How does data quality affect shared geometry? We mostly used image-caption datasets with relatively high-quality visual and textual descriptions. Yet, much of web-available text does not describe visual scenes and may thus share less semantic structure with vision representations. This limits the applicability of our current approach to noisier multimodal data, though our results suggest that it can be mitigated by improving representation quality. Language models already help identify text relevant to visual content ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and generative token pooling ( Wang et al., 2026 ) improves geometric alignment for short captions (see Appx. D ). These results suggest that better filtering and representations might extend unpaired cross-modal alignment to noisier settings.
paragraphs.zh: 数据质量如何影响共享几何结构？ 我们主要使用了图像-描述数据集，这些数据集的视觉和文本描述质量相对较高。 然而，网络上大部分可用文本并不描述视觉场景，因此可能与视觉表征共享较少的语义结构。 这限制了当前方法在更嘈杂的多模态数据上的适用性，尽管我们的结果表明，通过提升表征质量可以缓解这一问题。 语言模型已经有助于识别与视觉内容相关的文本（Zhang et al., 2026），而生成式标记池化（Wang et al., 2026）则能改善短描述文本的几何对齐效果（见附录 D）。 这些结果表明，更有效的过滤和表征方法或许能将无配对的跨模态对齐扩展到更嘈杂的数据环境。

sents.en: How does data quality affect shared geometry?
sents.zh: 数据质量如何影响共享几何结构？

sents.en: We mostly used image-caption datasets with relatively high-quality visual and textual descriptions.
sents.zh: 我们主要使用了图像-描述数据集，这些数据集的视觉和文本描述质量相对较高。

sents.en: Yet, much of web-available text does not describe visual scenes and may thus share less semantic structure with vision representations.
sents.zh: 然而，网络上大部分可用文本并不描述视觉场景，因此可能与视觉表征共享较少的语义结构。

sents.en: This limits the applicability of our current approach to noisier multimodal data, though our results suggest that it can be mitigated by improving representation quality.
sents.zh: 这限制了当前方法在更嘈杂的多模态数据上的适用性，尽管我们的结果表明，通过提升表征质量可以缓解这一问题。

sents.en: Language models already help identify text relevant to visual content ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and generative token pooling ( Wang et al., 2026 ) improves geometric alignment for short captions (see Appx. D ).
sents.zh: 语言模型已经有助于识别与视觉内容相关的文本（Zhang et al., 2026），而生成式标记池化（Wang et al., 2026）则能改善短描述文本的几何对齐效果（见附录 D）。

sents.en: These results suggest that better filtering and representations might extend unpaired cross-modal alignment to noisier settings.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，更有效的过滤和表征方法或许能将无配对的跨模态对齐扩展到更嘈杂的数据环境。

paragraphs.en: We showed that independently trained models across modalities can often be aligned without any paired data. A simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization recovers coarse cross-modal correspondences, even when modalities are drawn from different datasets. We further showed alignment success is strongly predicted by CKA scores, indicating that greater geometric similarity leads to better unpaired alignment. These findings are consistent across vision and language and extend to scientific and medical domains. Finally, paired supervision can be incorporated naturally into our framework. Our method substantially improves over existing approaches in the low-pair regime and remains competitive as more pairs become available. Taken together, our results suggest that a multimodal Rosetta Stone is not always necessary. In many cases, the geometry learned independently by different models already contains enough information to connect their modalities. Our work creates exciting opportunities for new modalities for which paired information is scarce or even non-existent, as long as sufficient geometry is shared between representations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，跨模态的独立训练模型通常无需任何配对数据即可实现对齐。 一种采用粗略几何初始化的简单瓦瑟斯坦普洛克拉斯方法，即使不同模态来自不同的数据集，也能恢复出粗略的跨模态对应关系。 我们进一步证明，CKA分数能够强有力地预测对齐的成功性，这表明几何相似性越高，无配对数据下的对齐效果越好。 这些发现无论是在视觉还是语言领域都保持一致，并可扩展至科学和医学领域。 最后，我们的框架可以自然地融入配对监督机制。 在配对数据稀少的情况下，我们的方法显著优于现有方法；随着可用配对数据的增加，其性能仍能保持竞争力。 综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，构建多模态的“罗塞塔石碑”并非总是必要的。 在许多情况下，不同模型独立学习到的几何结构已经包含了足够的信息来连接它们的模态。 只要不同表示之间共享了足够的几何信息，我们的工作就为那些配对信息稀缺甚至不存在的新模态创造了激动人心的机会。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides details about our algorithm and ablates it against other components and hyperparameter choices.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细介绍了我们的算法，并将其与其他组件及超参数选择进行了消融对比。

paragraphs.en: Algorithms 1 and 2 summarize the method. It consists of three steps: The initialization seeks a coarse transport that connects the two spaces, the read-out transforms the coarse transport into a sample-wise correspondence, and the refinement uses standard Wasserstein Procrustes alternation to improve the mapping.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 和 2 总结了该方法。 该方法包含三个步骤：初始化阶段寻找连接两个空间的粗略传输；读出阶段将粗略传输转换为样本级的对应关系；优化阶段则使用标准的 Wasserstein Procrustes 交替法来改进映射。

sents.en: Algorithms 1 and 2 summarize the method.
sents.zh: 算法 1 和 2 总结了该方法。

sents.en: It consists of three steps: The initialization seeks a coarse transport that connects the two spaces, the read-out transforms the coarse transport into a sample-wise correspondence, and the refinement uses standard Wasserstein Procrustes alternation to improve the mapping.
sents.zh: 该方法包含三个步骤：初始化阶段寻找连接两个空间的粗略传输；读出阶段将粗略传输转换为样本级的对应关系；优化阶段则使用标准的 Wasserstein Procrustes 交替法来改进映射。

Let 𝑿 ∈ ℝ n × d X {\bm{X}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d_{X}} and 𝒀 ∈ ℝ m × d Y {\bm{Y}}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d_{Y}} , d X ≤ d Y d_{X}\leq d_{Y} , be centered and normalized embeddings from independently trained models. We use 𝒂 = 𝟏 n / n {\bm{a}}={\bm{1}}_{n}/n and 𝒃 = 𝟏 m / m {\bm{b}}={\bm{1}}_{m}/m to denote the uniform marginals and Π ( 𝒂 , 𝒃 ) = { 𝑻 ∈ ℝ ≥ 0 n × m : 𝑻 𝟏 m = 𝒂 , 𝑻 ⊤ 𝟏 n = 𝒃 } \Pi({\bm{a}},{\bm{b}})=\{{\bm{T}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times m}_{\geq 0}:{\bm{T}}{\bm{1}}_{m}={\bm{a}},\ {\bm{T}}^{\top}{\bm{1}}_{n}={\bm{b}}\} for the transport polytope. The vertices of the transport polytope for square matrices are permutation matrices 𝒫 n \mathcal{P}_{n} . Moreover, we use the Stiefel manifold St ⁡ ( d X , d Y ) \St(d_{X},d_{Y}) , which is the set of semi-orthogonal matrices 𝑾 ∈ ℝ d X × d Y {\bm{W}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{X}\times d_{Y}} whose columns are orthogonal if d X ≥ d Y d_{X}\geq d_{Y} and whose rows are orthonormal otherwise. We can transform a matrix into a semi-orthogonal matrix with the polar factor polar ⁡ ( 𝑴 ) = 𝑼 ​ 𝑽 ⊤ \polar({\bm{M}})={\bm{U}}{\bm{V}}^{\top} using the singular value decomposition 𝑴 = 𝑼 ​ 𝚺 ​ 𝑽 ⊤ {\bm{M}}={\bm{U}}{\bm{\Sigma}}{\bm{V}}^{\top} . To ease the notation with Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problems, we denote the linear kernels as 𝑲 X = 𝑿 ​ 𝑿 ⊤ {\bm{K}}_{X}={\bm{X}}{\bm{X}}^{\top} and 𝑲 Y = 𝒀 ​ 𝒀 ⊤ {\bm{K}}_{Y}={\bm{Y}}{\bm{Y}}^{\top} . paragraphs.en: We don’t assume a perfect isometry but rather shared coarse structures in the embedding spaces. Therefore, we use the coarse clustering initialization from mini-vec2vec ( Dar, 2025 ) . This initialization repeatedly matches cluster centers to create a set of pseudo-pairs. This makes the problem computationally tractable and relies on shared coarse structures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不假设完美的等距性，而是认为嵌入空间中存在共享的粗略结构。 因此，我们使用 mini-vec2vec（Dar, 2025）中的粗略聚类初始化方法。 这种初始化方法通过重复匹配聚类中心来生成一组伪配对。 这使得该问题在计算上变得可行，并且依赖于共享的粗略结构。

paragraphs.en: The MPOpt solver natively handles a linear term. This also means that the complexity of the solver doesn’t depend on the number of pseudo pairs. During the Procrustes steps, the pairs also enter as a linear term and are weighted so that they carry the same total weight as the unpaired samples in the batch.
paragraphs.zh: MPOpt 求解器原生支持线性项。 这也意味着求解器的复杂度不取决于伪对的数量。 在 Procrustes 步骤中，这些对也以线性项的形式加入，并通过加权处理，使其总权重与批次中未配对的样本相同。

sents.en: This also means that the complexity of the solver doesn’t depend on the number of pseudo pairs.
sents.zh: 这也意味着求解器的复杂度不取决于伪对的数量。

sents.en: During the Procrustes steps, the pairs also enter as a linear term and are weighted so that they carry the same total weight as the unpaired samples in the batch.
sents.zh: 在 Procrustes 步骤中，这些对也以线性项的形式加入，并通过加权处理，使其总权重与批次中未配对的样本相同。

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility. Embeddings are stored in bfloat16, normalized to unit length, and cast to float32. The aligner subtracts the mean of its own training set and normalizes every row again. All random subsets are drawn without replacement, and every run is seeded once for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch with deterministic algorithms enabled. The clustering is scikit-learn’s KMeans with its default parameters, which include k ​ -means k\text{-means} ++ seeding, and the labels are reassigned to the nearest center afterwards. MPOpt is called through pylibmgm 1.1.2 in the variant whose primal heuristic is improved by the local search GRASP, with all costs shifted to be non-positive, which changes the objective by a constant only, and with a batch size of 100, 10 greedy generations, and the stopping rule p = 0.1 p=0.1 , k = 100 k=100 after at most 1000 batches. The assignments of the read-out and the refinement use SciPy’s linear_sum_assignment , a Jonker-Volgenant algorithm ( Jonker & Volgenant, 1987 ) , on float64 cost matrices. The polar factor is computed from the SVD of PyTorch and falls back to float64 when the float32 decomposition fails to converge. We use PyTorch 2.14, scikit-learn 1.9, SciPy 1.18, and five seeds for every reported number unless stated otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 可重复性。 嵌入向量以 bfloat16 格式存储，归一化为单位长度，并转换为 float32。 对齐器会减去其自身训练集的均值，并对每一行再次进行归一化。 所有随机子集均通过不放回抽样生成，且每次运行都会为 Python、NumPy 和 PyTorch 设置一次随机种子，同时启用确定性算法。 聚类采用 scikit-learn 的 KMeans 算法及其默认参数，其中包括 k-means k\text{-means}++ 初始化；之后会将标签重新分配至最近的中心点。 MPOpt 通过 pylibmgm 1.1.2 调用其特定变体：该变体的原始启发式方法由局部搜索 GRASP 改进，所有成本均被偏移为非正值（这仅以常数项改变目标函数），并设置批处理大小为 100、10 次贪婪生成，以及停止规则 p = 0.1、k = 100，最多执行 1000 个批处理后终止。 读取与优化阶段的分配操作使用 SciPy 的 linear_sum_assignment（一种 Jonker-Volgenant 算法，Jonker & Volgenant, 1987），作用于 float64 成本矩阵。 极因子通过 PyTorch 的 SVD 计算；当 float32 分解无法收敛时，则回退至 float64。 除非另有说明，否则我们使用 PyTorch 2.14、scikit-learn 1.9、SciPy 1.18，并为每个报告数值采用五个随机种子。

sents.zh: 可重复性。

sents.en: Embeddings are stored in bfloat16, normalized to unit length, and cast to float32.
sents.zh: 嵌入向量以 bfloat16 格式存储，归一化为单位长度，并转换为 float32。

sents.en: The aligner subtracts the mean of its own training set and normalizes every row again.
sents.zh: 对齐器会减去其自身训练集的均值，并对每一行再次进行归一化。

sents.en: All random subsets are drawn without replacement, and every run is seeded once for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch with deterministic algorithms enabled.

sents.en: The clustering is scikit-learn’s KMeans with its default parameters, which include k ​ -means k\text{-means} ++ seeding, and the labels are reassigned to the nearest center afterwards.
sents.zh: 聚类采用 scikit-learn 的 KMeans 算法及其默认参数，其中包括 k-means k\text{-means}++ 初始化；之后会将标签重新分配至最近的中心点。

sents.en: MPOpt is called through pylibmgm 1.1.2 in the variant whose primal heuristic is improved by the local search GRASP, with all costs shifted to be non-positive, which changes the objective by a constant only, and with a batch size of 100, 10 greedy generations, and the stopping rule p = 0.1 p=0.1 , k = 100 k=100 after at most 1000 batches.
sents.zh: MPOpt 通过 pylibmgm 1.1.2 调用其特定变体：该变体的原始启发式方法由局部搜索 GRASP 改进，所有成本均被偏移为非正值（这仅以常数项改变目标函数），并设置批处理大小为 100、10 次贪婪生成，以及停止规则 p = 0.1、k = 100，最多执行 1000 个批处理后终止。

sents.en: The assignments of the read-out and the refinement use SciPy’s linear_sum_assignment , a Jonker-Volgenant algorithm ( Jonker & Volgenant, 1987 ) , on float64 cost matrices.
sents.zh: 读取与优化阶段的分配操作使用 SciPy 的 linear_sum_assignment（一种 Jonker-Volgenant 算法，Jonker & Volgenant, 1987），作用于 float64 成本矩阵。

sents.en: The polar factor is computed from the SVD of PyTorch and falls back to float64 when the float32 decomposition fails to converge.
sents.zh: 极因子通过 PyTorch 的 SVD 计算；当 float32 分解无法收敛时，则回退至 float64。

sents.en: We use PyTorch 2.14, scikit-learn 1.9, SciPy 1.18, and five seeds for every reported number unless stated otherwise.
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，否则我们使用 PyTorch 2.14、scikit-learn 1.9、SciPy 1.18，并为每个报告数值采用五个随机种子。

paragraphs.en: Computational cost. Let I I be the number of Lloyd iterations and d = max ⁡ ( d X , d Y ) d=\max(d_{X},d_{Y}) . One clustering run costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( b ​ C ​ d ​ I ) \mathcal{O}(bCdI) for the two k ​ -means k\text{-means} and 𝒪 ⁡ ( C 2 ​ d ) \mathcal{O}(C^{2}d) for the kernels, and the QAP solver runs in 𝒪 ⁡ ( C 4 ) \mathcal{O}(C^{4}) , which takes seconds for C = 30 C=30 . The S S runs are independent. The read-out and the refinement are ⌈ min ⁡ ( n , m ) / b ⌉ + R \lceil\min(n,m)/b\rceil+R assignments of size b b , each preceded by a score matrix in 𝒪 ⁡ ( b 2 ​ d ) \mathcal{O}(b^{2}d) and solved in 𝒪 ⁡ ( b 3 ) \mathcal{O}(b^{3}) in the worst case, and each followed by a Procrustes step in 𝒪 ⁡ ( d X ​ d Y ​ min ⁡ ( d X , d Y ) ) \mathcal{O}(d_{X}d_{Y}\min(d_{X},d_{Y})) . No stage forms an n × m n\times m matrix. paragraphs.en: We perform two ablation studies: one study to compare our choice of components with other choices made in the literature ( Sec. A.2.1 ) and one study showing the robustness of our four hyperparameters ( Sec. A.2.2 ). We evaluate on DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) with Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and generative token pooling ( Wang et al., 2026 ) on MS COCO ( Chen et al., 2015 ) , GTR ( Ni et al., 2022 ) with GTE ( Li et al., 2023 ) on NQ ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) , and the RNA and ATAC embeddings of SNARE-seq ( Chen et al., 2019 ) , and report FOSCTTM over five seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了两项消融研究：一项研究旨在将我们所选择的组件与文献中其他选择进行比较（第 A.2.1 节），另一项研究则展示了我们四个超参数的鲁棒性（第 A.2.2 节）。我们在 MS COCO（Chen et al., 2015）上，使用 DINOv2 ViT-B/14（Oquab et al., 2024）、Qwen3-8B（Yang et al., 2025）和生成式标记池化（Wang et al., 2026）进行评估；在 NQ（Kwiatkowski et al., 2019）上，使用 GTR（Ni et al., 2022）和 GTE（Li et al., 2023）进行评估；此外，还评估了 SNARE-seq（Chen et al., 2019）的 RNA 和 ATAC 嵌入，并报告了基于五个随机种子的 FOSCTTM 结果。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial methods usually approximate the distance with discriminators, corresponding to the Jensen-Shannon divergence for the standard GAN loss ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) , Wasserstein-1 distance for Wasserstein-GAN ( Arjovsky et al., 2017 ) , or any f f -divergence ( Nowozin et al., 2016 ) . This gives adversarial methods the advantage that the function space ℱ \mathcal{F} can be chosen more freely. Nonetheless, most of them choose simple MLPs ( Jha et al., 2026 ) , linear transformations ( Hoshen & Wolf, 2018b ; Zhang et al., 2017b ; Xu et al., 2018 ) , or orthogonal transformations ( Conneau et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2017a ) . Finally, the adversarial loss is often only the initialization and is usually further refined with optimization-based refinements ( Conneau et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2017b ; Mohiuddin & Joty, 2019 ) . In general, recent work ( Jha et al., 2026 ; Dar, 2025 ) finds that adversarial methods are generally very unstable, and we can confirm this observation even more strongly in our unpaired experiments ( Sec. 4.1 ). Therefore, we mainly consider optimization-based methods in our ablation study.
paragraphs.zh: 对抗方法通常使用判别器来近似距离，这对应于标准 GAN 损失中的 Jensen-Shannon 散度（Goodfellow 等人，2014）、Wasserstein-GAN 中的 Wasserstein-1 距离（Arjovsky 等人，2017），或任意的 f-f 散度（Nowozin 等人，2016）。 这使得对抗方法具有优势，即函数空间 ℱ \mathcal{F} 可以更加自由地选择。 尽管如此，大多数方法仍选择简单的 MLP（Jha 等人，2026）、线性变换（Hoshen & Wolf，2018b；Zhang 等人，2017b；Xu 等人，2018）或正交变换（Conneau 等人，2018；Zhang 等人，2017a）。 最后，对抗损失通常仅作为初始化，并且一般会通过基于优化的优化方法进一步改进（Conneau 等人，2018；Zhang 等人，2017b；Mohiuddin & Joty，2019）。 总体而言，近期的研究（Jha 等人，2026；Dar，2025）发现，对抗方法通常非常不稳定，而我们在无配对实验中（第 4.1 节）甚至能更强烈地证实这一观察结果。 因此，在我们的消融研究中，我们主要考虑基于优化的方法。

paragraphs.en: Initialization. The Wasserstein Procrustes problem is jointly non-convex ( Alvarez-Melis et al., 2019 ) and Gromov-Wasserstein is NP-hard in general ( Scetbon et al., 2022 ) . Therefore, a variety of heuristics have been introduced to initialize the correspondence. Artetxe et al. (2018) sorts each row of both kernel square roots to find a correspondence between the distance distributions (sorted heuristic), and Hoshen & Wolf (2018a) takes inspiration from 3D point cloud matching and matches the leading PCA dimensions (PCA heuristic). We also compare a random and uniform transport initialization refined with conditional gradient ( Peyré et al., 2016 ) on 1024 samples – Gromov-Wasserstein (random) and Gromov-Wasserstein (uniform) – and the original mini-vec2vec initialization with 2-opt and two different numbers of clusters. We do not perform any refinement and use the same readout on all of them.
paragraphs.zh: 初始化。 Wasserstein Procrustes 问题是联合非凸的（Alvarez-Melis 等，2019），而 Gromov-Wasserstein 问题在一般情况下是 NP-难的（Scetbon 等，2022）。 因此，人们提出了多种启发式方法来初始化对应关系。Artetxe 等 （2018）对两个核平方根的每行进行排序，以找到距离分布之间的对应关系（排序启发式方法），而 Hoshen & Wolf（2018a）则从三维点云匹配中获取灵感，并匹配领先的主成分分析维度（PCA 启发式方法）。 我们还比较了随机和均匀传输初始化，并通过条件梯度法进行优化（Peyré 等，2016），在 1024 个样本上测试了 Gromov-Wasserstein（随机）和 Gromov-Wasserstein（均匀）方法，以及原始 mini-vec2vec 初始化和结合 2-opt 及两种不同簇数的方法。 我们没有进行任何优化，并在所有方法中使用了相同的读出机制。

paragraphs.en: On the small SNARE-seq benchmark, all solvers are competitive, but the two heuristics are slightly worse. For the NQ and MS COCO datasets, a clear pattern is observable. On NQ, all heuristics and Gromov-Wasserstein initializations perform near chance, and on MS COCO they stay far behind matching cluster centers. Matching cluster centers makes the problem solvable, and the quality of the solver mainly determines the quality of the alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 在小型的 SNARE-seq 基准测试中，所有求解器都具有竞争力，但两种启发式方法的表现略差一些。 对于 NQ 和 MS COCO 数据集，可以观察到一个明显的规律。 在 NQ 上，所有启发式方法和 Gromov-Wasserstein 初始化的表现都接近随机水平；而在 MS COCO 上，它们则远远落后于匹配簇中心的方法。 匹配簇中心使问题变得可解，而求解器的质量主要决定了对齐的质量。

With the heuristic, MPOpt returns the certified optimum up to 40 classes, and beyond that a permutation at least as good as that of the Hahn-Grant algorithm in a fraction of the time. paragraphs.en: Read-out. Given a coarse transport plan, there are multiple methods to extend it to the sample level. Alvarez-Melis & Jaakkola (2018) apply one Procrustes step to the plan, which for our plan is polar ⁡ ( 𝑴 ) \polar({\bm{M}}) and which we call the direct read-out. mini-vec2vec proposes the direct read-out and a read-out through relative representations ( Moschella et al., 2023 ) . It compares the relative representations of a source and a target by their cosine and averages the k k nearest targets of every source. Our read-out is one conditional-gradient step on the GW objective from 𝑻 ¯ \bar{{\bm{T}}} , as described in Sec. A.1 . The relative representation and the conditional gradient step implicitly optimize similar objectives. This can be seen when expanding ( 𝑿 𝑴 𝒀 ⊤ ) i ​ j = 1 S ​ C ⟨ ( 𝑿 𝑨 1 : S ⊤ ) i , ( 𝒀 𝑩 1 : S ⊤ ) j ⟩ \left({\bm{X}}{\bm{M}}{\bm{Y}}^{\top}\right)_{ij}=\tfrac{1}{SC}\left\langle\left({\bm{X}}{\bm{A}}_{1:S}^{\top}\right)_{i},\left({\bm{Y}}{\bm{B}}_{1:S}^{\top}\right)_{j}\right\rangle . Hence, the mini-vec2vec read-out differs mainly in that it uses cosine similarities instead of inner products and the top- k k neighbors instead of a batched linear assignment.

paragraphs.en: Refinement. For the refinement, we compare our standard Wasserstein Procrustes alternation with the two-stage refinement from mini-vec2vec. The first refinement replaces the transport with the average over the top- k k neighbors, and it updates the weight with an exponential moving average of the Procrustes solutions. Compared to our refinement, this adds two additional hyperparameters and produces an average over semi-orthogonal matrices, which is not semi-orthogonal in general. The second refinement clusters the source space with k k -means and uses the mapped cluster centers as initialization for clustering in the target space. This again corresponds to a low-rank transport plan, and an exponential moving with Procrustes is used for the weight update. This adds two further hyperparameters, namely the number of refinement steps with the second refinement and the number of clusters in the second refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 优化。 在优化过程中，我们将标准的瓦瑟斯坦普罗克鲁斯特交替方法与 mini-vec2vec 中的两阶段优化方法进行比较。 第一种优化方法用前 k 个邻居的平均值替换了传输过程，并通过普罗克鲁斯特解的指数移动平均来更新权重。 与我们的优化方法相比，这种方法增加了两个额外的超参数，并对半正交矩阵进行平均，而该结果通常并非半正交。 第二种优化方法使用 k-均值对源空间进行聚类，并将映射后的聚类中心用作目标空间中聚类的初始化。 这同样对应于一个低秩传输计划，并且权重更新使用了普罗克鲁斯特解的指数移动平均。 这又增加了两个超参数，即第二种优化方法的优化步数以及第二种优化方法中的聚类数量。

paragraphs.en: The last section shows that our method outperforms previous methods while being simpler. It only contains four hyperparameters: the number of clusters C C , the batch size b b , and the number of iterations during initialization S S and refinement R R . This section shows that our method is stable with respect to all of them, and choosing them larger generally improves the performance while trading off speed.
paragraphs.zh: 最后一部分表明，我们的方法比先前的方法更简单，同时性能也更优。 它仅包含四个超参数：簇的数量 C C、批量大小 b b，以及初始化阶段的迭代次数 S S 和精修阶段的迭代次数 R R。 本部分表明，我们的方法对所有这些参数都表现出稳定性，并且增大这些参数通常能提升性能，但会牺牲一定的速度。

paragraphs.en: General setup. Every experiment fits the aligner of Sec. A.1 with the same hyperparameters, C = 30 C=30 clusters, S = 30 S=30 restarts, a batch size of b = 10 4 b=10^{4} and R = 100 R=100 refinement iterations. Each side is preprocessed by subtracting the mean of its own training samples and normalizing every row to unit length, with a numerical floor of 10 − 10 10^{-10} . The two training sets are disjoint. We draw one random permutation of the corpus, give the first half to one modality and the second half to the other, so no sample is seen on both sides and no correspondence between the two sets exists. In the cross-dataset setting the two sides are drawn independently from two different corpora instead. Every experiment is repeated with five seeds, drawn once from a generator seeded with 42 42 , and the tables and figures report the mean and the standard deviation over those five runs. The exceptions are the geometry scores and the text-to-image retrieval, which use one seed, and the fMRI benchmark and the granularity experiments, which use ten seeds. Embeddings are computed once and cached in bfloat16 . A language corpus stores several texts per item, for instance the five captions of an image or the three repeats of a generative prompt, as a padded tensor. Such a tensor is reduced by normalizing every row, averaging over the texts of an item while ignoring the padding, and normalizing the result again.
paragraphs.zh: 通用设置。每次实验均使用相同的超参数配置第 A.1 节的对齐器：C = 30 C=30 个簇、S = 30 S=30 次重启、批量大小 b = 10⁴ b=10^{4}，以及 R = 100 R=100 次优化迭代。每侧数据均经过预处理：先减去各自训练样本的均值，再将每一行归一化为单位长度，并设置数值下限为 10⁻¹⁰ 10^{-10}。两个训练集互不相交。我们从语料库中抽取一个随机排列，将前半部分分配给一种模态，后半部分分配给另一种模态，因此没有任何样本会同时出现在两侧，且两个集合之间不存在对应关系。在跨数据集设置中，两侧数据则分别独立地从两个不同的语料库中抽取。每次实验均使用五个种子重复进行，这些种子从以 42 42 为种子的生成器中一次性抽取；表格和图表报告了这五次运行结果的均值和标准差。例外情况包括几何分数和文本到图像检索任务（仅使用一个种子），以及 fMRI 基准测试和粒度实验（使用十个种子）。嵌入向量仅计算一次，并以 bfloat16 格式缓存。语言语料库中每个条目存储多个文本，例如一张图片的五个标题或一个生成提示的三个重复版本，并以填充张量的形式存储。此类张量通过以下方式进行降维：先对每一行进行归一化，然后在忽略填充的情况下对同一条目内的文本取平均，最后再次对结果进行归一化。

paragraphs.en: Geometry metrics. Four measures of how similar the two embedding geometries are enter Secs. 4.1 and 4.3 . CKA is the linear centered kernel alignment of Kornblith et al. (2019) with the unbiased estimator of the Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion (HSIC). Mutual k k -NN is the measure of Huh et al. (2024) , the average overlap of the k k nearest neighbors of a sample in the two spaces, with k = 10 k=10 , an inner-product kernel and the sample itself excluded. TSI and QSI ( Soares et al., 2026 ) are the fractions of sampled triplets ( i , j , k ) (i,j,k) with d ⁡ ( i , j ) < d ⁡ ( i , k ) d(i,j)<d(i,k) and of sampled quadruplets ( i , j , k , l ) (i,j,k,l) with d ⁡ ( i , j ) < d ⁡ ( k , l ) d(i,j)<d(k,l) whose ordering agrees in both spaces, each estimated from 10 5 10^{5} samples. All four are computed on 10,000 10{,}000 paired validation samples with each side centered. A corpus with fewer than 10,000 10{,}000 paired samples contributes all of them, without repetition. Several of the modality pairs of Sec. 4.3 are far below that, the smallest being 123 123 paired slides for tissue against MRI, 149 149 words for MEG against text and 168 168 patients for tissue against CT. Their geometry scores are therefore estimated from a few hundred points rather than ten thousand and carry much more variance than the vision-language ones. All three of those pairs sit at chance in Tab. 12 , so the conclusion drawn from them is that there is no alignment to find, which a noisy estimate supports as much as a precise one.
paragraphs.zh: 几何度量。衡量两种嵌入几何结构相似性的四种指标见第4.1节和第4.3节。CKA是Kornblith等人（2019）提出的线性中心化核对齐方法，结合了希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的无偏估计量。相互k k -NN是Huh等人（2024）提出的一种度量，用于衡量一个样本在两个空间中的前k k个最近邻的平均重叠程度，其中k = 10 k=10，并使用内积核，同时排除样本本身。TSI和QSI（Soares等人，2026）分别表示采样三元组（i, j, k）(i,j,k)中满足d⁡(i, j) < d⁡(i, k) d(i,j)<d(i,k)的比例，以及采样四元组（i, j, k, l）(i,j,k,l)中满足d⁡(i, j) < d⁡(k, l) d(i,j)<d(k,l)且排序在两个空间中都一致的比例；这些指标均基于10⁵个样本进行估计。这四种指标均在10,000个成对验证样本上计算，且每侧数据均已中心化。若语料库中的成对样本少于10,000个，则全部使用这些样本，不重复计算。第4.3节中的一些模态组合远未达到这一数量：组织与MRI的成对切片最少，为123个；MEG与文本的单词数为149个；组织与CT的患者数为168个。因此，它们的几何得分是基于数百个点而非一万点估计得出的，因而比视觉-语言组合的得分具有更大的方差。在表12中，这三种模态组合的结果均处于随机水平，由此得出的结论是：不存在可发现的对齐关系——这一结论无论基于噪声较大的估计还是精确的估计，都同样成立。

paragraphs.en: Unpaired cross-modal alignment ( Sec. 4.1 ). The grid is seven vision models against three language models on four corpora. The vision models are iBOT ViT-B/16 and iBOT Swin-T/14 ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) , DINOv2 ViT-B/14 and DINOv2 ViT-G/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , Franca ViT-G/14 ( Venkataramanan et al., 2026 ) trained on LAION ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) in both its class-token and its mean-pooled read-out, and DINOv3 ViT-7B/16 at a resolution of 512 512 pixels ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) . All of them are used at a resolution of 224 224 pixels except DINOv3, and all are mean pooled over the class, register and patch tokens except the class-token variant of Franca. The language models are all-mpnet-base-v2 from Sentence Transformers ( Reimers & Gurevych, 2019 ) , Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with the generative token pooling of Wang et al. (2026) . Generative pooling prompts the model with Imagine what it would look like to see: followed by the caption, generates at most 128 128 tokens, and averages the hidden states of the generated tokens. The prompt is repeated three times and the three results are averaged. The corpora are MS COCO 2014 train with 82,783 82{,}783 images and up to seven captions each ( Chen et al., 2015 ) , Stanford Paragraph Captioning with 19,561 19{,}561 images ( Krause et al., 2017 ) , Densely Captioned Images with 7,805 7{,}805 images in its extended caption variant ( Urbanek et al., 2024 ) , and DOCCI with 14,847 14{,}847 images ( Onoe et al., 2024 ) . Validation always uses the 40,504 40{,}504 images of MS COCO 2014 val ( Chen et al., 2015 ) . The cross-dataset setting takes the images from MS COCO and the captions from Stanford Paragraph Captioning, so the two sides describe different scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 非配对跨模态对齐（第 4.1 节）。 该网格包含七种视觉模型和三种语言模型，基于四个语料库进行对比。 视觉模型包括 iBOT ViT-B/16 和 iBOT Swin-T/14（Zhou 等，2022）、DINOv2 ViT-B/14 和 DINOv2 ViT-G/14（Oquab 等，2024）、Franca ViT-G/14（Venkataramanan 等，2026），这些模型均在 LAION（Schuhmann 等，2022）上训练，涵盖其类标记和均值池化输出；此外还包括分辨率为 512×512 像素的 DINOv3 ViT-7B/16（Siméoni 等，2026）。 除 DINOv3 外，所有模型均使用 224×224 像素的分辨率；除 Franca 的类标记变体外，所有模型均在类、注册和块标记上进行均值池化。 语言模型包括来自 Sentence Transformers（Reimers & Gurevych，2019）的 all-mpnet-base-v2、Qwen3-Embedding-8B（Zhang 等，2025）以及 Qwen3-8B（Yang 等，2025），并采用 Wang 等（2026）提出的生成式标记池化方法。 生成式池化通过提示“想象一下看到它会是怎样的：”后接图像标题来引导模型，最多生成 128×128 个标记，并对生成的标记的隐藏状态取平均值。 该提示重复三次，并将三次结果取平均。 语料库包括 MS COCO 2014 训练集（含 82,783 张图像，每张最多七个标题，Chen 等，2015）、Stanford Paragraph Captioning（含 19,561 张图像，Krause 等，2017）、Densely Captioned Images（其扩展标题变体含 7,805 张图像，Urbanek 等，2024）以及 DOCCI（含 14,847 张图像，Onoe 等，2024）。 验证始终使用 MS COCO 2014 验证集中的 40,504 张图像（Chen 等，2015）。 跨数据集设置中，图像来自 MS COCO，而标题来自 Stanford Paragraph Captioning，因此两侧描述的是不同的场景。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot classification. The same aligners are evaluated on CIFAR-10 ( Krizhevsky et al., 2009 ) , CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky et al., 2009 ) and ImageNet-100 ( Tian et al., 2020 ) by mapping the image embeddings into the language space and retrieving the nearest class prompt. CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 use the same 18 18 photo templates from CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , such as a photo of a {} and a blurry photo of the {} , and the class embedding is the average over the templates. ImageNet-100 uses no template and embeds the class name followed by its WordNet definition. We report top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 and top-5 accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本分类。 我们将相同的对齐器在 CIFAR-10（Krizhevsky 等人，2009）、CIFAR-100（Krizhevsky 等人，2009）和 ImageNet-100（Tian 等人，2020）上进行评估，具体方法是将图像嵌入映射到语言空间，并检索最近的类别提示。 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 使用来自 CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）的相同 18 个 18 像素照片模板，例如一张 {} 的照片和一张模糊的 {} 照片，而类别嵌入则是这些模板的平均值。 ImageNet-100 不使用任何模板，而是将类别名称与其 WordNet 定义一同进行嵌入。 我们在 CIFAR-10 上报告 top-1 准确率，在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet-100 上报告 top-5 准确率。

paragraphs.en: Few-pair alignment ( Sec. 4.4 ). This experiment uses MS COCO with DINOv2 ViT-B/14 against Qwen3-8B with generative pooling, and varies the number of known pairs over 0 0 , 1 1 , 2 2 , 5 5 , 10 10 , 20 20 , 50 50 , 100 100 , 200 200 , 500 500 and 1000 1000 . The pairs enter all three stages, as the linear term of the quadratic assignment problem in Lemma 3 and as an additional term in both Procrustes steps. Every baseline receives exactly the same pairs and the same validation data.

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image generation ( Sec. 4.5 ). A caption is embedded, mapped into the image space by the aligner, and generated by a diffusion model conditioned on the image embedding. We use a representation autoencoder (RAE, Zheng et al. (2026) ) as a diffusion model. Instead of text conditioning, we condition the diffusion transformer on the mean-pooled DINOv2 ViT-B/14 embeddings with registers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) , which is the encoder of the RAE. We train the diffusion transformer on ImageNet-1K with center crop of 256 256 pixels for 400 400 epochs with a global batch size of 256 256 on 4 × 4\times A40 GPUs. During generation, we sample images with 250 250 steps and a guidance scale of 1.0 1.0 . The resulting unnoised patch embeddings are then decoded into images by the pretrained RAE decoder. The whole diffusion model is trained exclusively on image data and never sees a caption, so the language side enters exclusively through the aligner. The language models are all-mpnet-base-v2 and Contriever ( Izacard et al., 2022 ) . The aligner is fitted on MS COCO 2014 train and the number of known pairs is varied over 0 0 to 100 100 . The eight captions shown are fixed across all grids, and one seed is used throughout, so that two grids differ only in the aligner. The linear baseline is the least-squares map from the same known pairs, obtained from the pseudo-inverse, with the same preprocessing. With zero pairs it is an arbitrary map and generates unrelated images.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像生成（第 4.5 节）。 一个描述性标题被嵌入，通过对齐器映射到图像空间，并由以图像嵌入为条件的扩散模型生成。 我们使用一个表示自编码器（RAE，Zheng 等人， (2026)）作为扩散模型。 我们不采用文本条件约束，而是将扩散变换器的条件设置为带有注册表（Darcet 等人，2024）的平均池化 DINOv2 ViT-B/14 嵌入，这是 RAE 的编码器。 我们在 ImageNet-1K 上训练扩散变换器，使用 256×256 像素的中心裁剪，进行 400 个周期，全局批量大小为 256，在 4×4 A40 GPU 上运行。 在生成过程中，我们以 250 步和 1.0 的指导尺度采样图像。 随后，得到的未加噪声的补丁嵌入由预训练的 RAE 解码器解码为图像。 整个扩散模型仅基于图像数据进行训练，从未接触过描述性标题，因此语言部分完全通过对齐器引入。 语言模型均为 all-mpnet-base-v2 和 Contriever（Izacard 等人，2022）。 对齐器在 MS COCO 2014 训练集上进行拟合，已知配对的数量在 0 到 100 之间变化。 所示的八个描述性标题在所有网格中均固定不变，且全程使用一个种子值，因此两个网格仅在对齐器上存在差异。 线性基线是从相同已知配对中通过伪逆得到的最小二乘映射，并采用相同的预处理方法。 当没有配对时，这是一个任意的映射，会生成无关的图像。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image scores. We score the generated images on two sets of prompts. The first set is the test split of CyclePrefDB-T2I ( Bahng et al., 2025 ) , whose 380 380 prompts summarize dense captions of DCI photographs ( Urbanek et al., 2024 ) . We take the photograph of each prompt from the test split of CyclePrefDB-I2T, which holds the same photographs in the same order. The second set has one caption for each of the 40,504 40{,}504 images of the MS COCO 2014 validation split, namely the caption with the lowest annotation id. Every setting generates one image per prompt. The initial noise depends only on the prompt, so all aligners start from the same noise. As a model trained on paired data, we use Scale-RAE ( Tong et al., 2026 ) , which combines Qwen2.5-1.5B with a diffusion transformer of 2.4 2.4 B parameters and generates images of 224 224 pixels. We sample it as its own evaluation script does, with the prefix Generate an image of and a guidance scale of 1.0 1.0 . Every image is scored against its prompt with four measures. CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) is the rescaled cosine similarity between the CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings of the image and of the caption. VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) is the probability that CLIP-FlanT5-XL assigns to the answer Yes for the question whether the image shows the caption. TIFA ( Hu et al., 2023 ) generates question and answer pairs from the caption with its open LLaMA-2 ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) question generator and keeps only those that a question answering model answers correctly from the caption alone. The score is the fraction of the kept questions that a visual question answering model answers correctly on the image. We use the official implementation with its released LLaMA-2 question generator instead of GPT-3.5 and with BLIP-large as the visual question answering model, which answers freely. An answer that is not one of the choices counts as the closest choice under Sentence-BERT ( Reimers & Gurevych, 2019 ) . CycleReward ( Bahng et al., 2025 ) is a learned preference model with an arbitrary scale, so only differences between methods are meaningful. We use its Combo checkpoint. We report the mean and the standard error over prompts, and TIFA leaves out the prompts for which no question passes the filter.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像得分。 我们对生成图像在两组提示上进行评分。 第一组是 CyclePrefDB-T2I（Bahng 等人，2025）的测试集，其中包含 380 个提示，这些提示总结了 DCI 照片（Urbanek 等人，2024）的密集描述。 我们从 CyclePrefDB-I2T 的测试集中获取每个提示对应的照片，该测试集包含相同顺序的同一批照片。 第二组为 MS COCO 2014 验证集中的 40,504 张图像各提供一个描述，即标注 ID 最低的描述。 每种设置都会为每个提示生成一张图像。 初始噪声仅取决于提示，因此所有对齐器都从相同的噪声开始。 由于这是一个在配对数据上训练的模型，我们使用 Scale-RAE（Tong 等人，2026），它将 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与一个包含 24 亿参数的扩散变换器结合，生成分辨率为 224×224 像素的图像。 我们按照其自身的评估脚本进行采样，使用前缀“生成一张……的图像”和引导尺度为 1.0。 每张图像都通过四项指标与其对应的提示进行评分。 CLIPScore（Hessel 等人，2021）是图像与描述在 CLIP ViT-L/14 嵌入空间中的余弦相似度经重新缩放后的结果。 VQAScore（Lin 等人，2024）是 CLIP-FlanT5-XL 对“图像是否展示了该描述”这一问题给出“是”这一答案的概率。 TIFA（Hu 等人，2023）使用其开源的 LLaMA-2（Touvron 等人，2023）问题生成器从描述中生成问答对，并仅保留那些问答模型仅凭描述就能正确回答的问题。 该得分是保留问题中视觉问答模型在图像上正确回答的比例。 我们使用官方实现及其发布的 LLaMA-2 问题生成器（而非 GPT-3.5），并以 BLIP-large 作为自由回答的视觉问答模型。 如果答案不是选项之一，则根据 Sentence-BERT（Reimers & Gurevych，2019）将其计为最接近的选项。 CycleReward（Bahng 等人，2025）是一个具有任意尺度的学习偏好模型，因此只有不同方法之间的差异才有意义。 我们使用其 Combo 检查点。 我们报告各提示的平均值和标准误差，而 TIFA 会排除那些没有通过过滤的问题所对应的提示。

paragraphs.en: Domain-specific alignment ( Sec. 4.2 ). Three benchmarks from three fields, each aligning two spaces that no shared encoder connects. The first is Natural Questions (NQ) ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) , where two different sentence encoders embed the same 5,332,023 5{,}332{,}023 passages. The last 8192 8192 passages are the paired validation set and the two disjoint training halves take 250,000 250{,}000 passages each. The five encoders (granite ( Awasthy et al., 2025 ) , e5 ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , gte ( Li et al., 2023 ) , gtr ( Ni et al., 2022 ) , stella ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) ) give ten ordered pairs. The second is the PBMC benchmark ( 10x Genomics, 2021 ) of 2407 2407 cells measured with two assays, with gene expression reduced to 50 50 principal components and chromatin accessibility to 50 50 topics. We additionally report label transfer accuracy (LTA), the fraction of cells whose cell type is recovered from the nearest neighbor in the other assay. The third is the fMRI benchmark of the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) ( Allen et al., 2022 ) , in the setting of Marcos-Manchón et al. (2026) , where a per-subject encoder maps brain responses of eight subjects into a shared 128 128 -dimensional space. The eight subjects give 56 56 ordered pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 领域特定对齐（第 4.2 节）。来自三个领域的三个基准测试，每个基准测试都对两个没有共享编码器连接的语义空间进行对齐。第一个是 Natural Questions (NQ)（Kwiatkowski 等人，2019），其中两种不同的句子编码器对相同的 5,332,023 个语段进行嵌入。最后 8192 个语段构成配对验证集，而两个互斥的训练部分各包含 250,000 个语段。五种编码器（granite（Awasthy 等人，2025）、e5（Wang 等人，2022）、gte（Li 等人，2023）、gtr（Ni 等人，2022）、stella（Zhang 等人，2024））产生了十个有序对。第二个是 PBMC 基准测试（10x Genomics，2021），包含使用两种检测方法测量的 2407 个细胞，其基因表达被降维至 50 个主成分，染色质可及性则被降维至 50 个主题。我们还报告了标签转移准确率（LTA），即通过另一种检测数据中的最近邻恢复出细胞类型的细胞比例。第三个是 Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD)（Allen 等人，2022）的 fMRI 基准测试，采用 Marcos-Manchón 等人（2026）的设置，其中每个受试者的专属编码器将八名受试者的脑响应映射到一个共享的 128 维空间。这八名受试者产生了 56 个有序对。
