paragraphs.en: Figs. 9 , 10 , 11 and 12 repeat the main figure for every dataset, MS COCO as in the main text and the three detailed captioning corpora. The cross-dataset results are shown in Fig. 13 in which the images come from MS COCO and the captions from Stanford Paragraph Captioning, so that no correspondence between the two sets exists. For all datasets, most vision and language models can be aligned well without any pairs and on every dataset our aligner outperforms the baselines mini-vec2vec and vec2vec on average. In general, iBOT ViT-B/16 performs worse than the other vision models. On all detailed captioning datasets, the generative token pooling performs substantially worse. Appx. D shows that this method is mostly beneficial for short captions and hurts on long ones. Mean pooling for Franca ViT-G/14 performs similar to taking the [CLS] token. Finally, we don’t observe a strong trend that bigger models can be aligned better, even though our study is not big enough to conclude on this point.

paragraphs.en: The results do not depend on MS COCO captions in the training data of the text encoder. MPNet is trained on a mixture of sentence pairs that includes MS COCO captions, so it could have seen the captions our aligner is fitted on. Contriever is trained on web text without MS COCO. With Contriever, the grids show the same progression with the number of pairs, and our aligner scores higher than the linear map on all four measures and for every number of pairs ( Tab. 6 ). Without any pairs, our aligner with Contriever even scores higher on CyclePrefDB than the linear map with 10 10 pairs with a TIFA of 0.419 0.419 against 0.389 0.389 . Contriever gives lower scores than MPNet overall, but the ordering between the two methods is the same for both encoders.
paragraphs.zh: 结果并不依赖于文本编码器训练数据中的 MS COCO 描述。 MPNet 是在包含 MS COCO 描述的混合句子对上训练的，因此它可能已经见过我们的对齐器所拟合的描述。 Contriever 是在没有 MS COCO 的网页文本上训练的。 使用 Contriever 时，网格随着句子对数量的变化呈现出相同的趋势，并且我们的对齐器在所有四项指标和每种句子对数量上的得分都高于线性映射（表 6）。 在没有任何句子对的情况下，使用 Contriever 的我们的对齐器在 CyclePrefDB 上的得分甚至高于使用 10×10 句子对的线性映射，其 TIFA 为 0.419 对比 0.389。 总体而言，Contriever 的得分低于 MPNet，但两种方法之间的排序在这两个编码器中保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We also measure how faithful the samples are on two sets of prompts, the 380 380 test prompts of CyclePrefDB ( Bahng et al., 2025 ) , which summarize dense captions of photographs, and one caption for each of the 40,504 40{,}504 images of the MS COCO 2014 validation split. Every setting generates one image per prompt, and all aligners start from the same noise for a given prompt. We compare against the real image of each prompt and against Scale-RAE ( Tong et al., 2026 ) , which conditions an RAE diffusion model directly on a language model and is trained on tens of millions of image-text pairs. Every image is scored against its prompt with the four measures of Appx. B . On CyclePrefDB, our aligner scores higher than the linear map on all four measures, for every number of pairs and with both text encoders ( Tab. 6 ). With MPNet and no pairs, our samples reach a CLIPScore of 0.466 0.466 , a VQAScore of 0.458 0.458 and a TIFA of 0.552 0.552 , which is above the linear map with 100 100 pairs at 0.411 0.411 , 0.334 0.334 and 0.507 0.507 . Adding pairs improves our aligner only slightly, to 0.510 0.510 , 0.511 0.511 and 0.615 0.615 at 100 100 pairs. Contriever gives slightly lower scores than MPNet, but the ordering between the two methods stays the same. Scale-RAE and the real images both reach a VQAScore and a TIFA above 0.82 0.82 . The gap to both is expected, because only the aligner connects our diffusion model to text, using at most 100 100 pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测量了样本在两组提示上的保真度：CyclePrefDB（Bahng 等人，2025）的 380 个测试提示，这些提示总结了照片的密集描述；以及 MS COCO 2014 验证集 40,504 张图片中的每张图片的一个描述。 每种设置都为每个提示生成一张图像，并且对于给定的提示，所有对齐器都从相同的噪声开始。 我们将结果与每个提示的真实图像以及 Scale-RAE（Tong 等人，2026）进行比较；Scale-RAE 直接将 RAE 扩散模型以语言模型为条件，并在数千万个图像-文本对上进行训练。 每张图像都使用附录 B 中的四种衡量标准，与对应的提示进行评分。 在 CyclePrefDB 上，对于每对图像-文本的数量以及两种文本编码器，我们的对齐器在这四种衡量标准上的得分均高于线性映射（表 6）。 使用 MPNet 且没有图像-文本对时，我们的样本的 CLIPScore 达到 0.466、VQAScore 为 0.458、TIFA 为 0.552，这高于使用 100 对图像-文本时的线性映射得分（分别为 0.411、0.334 和 0.507）。 添加图像-文本对仅略微提升了我们的对齐器性能：在 100 对时，得分达到 0.510、0.511 和 0.615。 Contriever 的得分略低于 MPNet，但两种方法之间的排名顺序保持不变。 Scale-RAE 和真实图像的 VQAScore 与 TIFA 均超过了 0.82。 与两者存在差距是意料之中的，因为只有对齐器将我们的扩散模型与文本连接起来，且最多仅使用 100 对图像-文本。

paragraphs.en: Which measure predicts best. Across these domains CKA and TSI both track the alignment, while mutual k k -NN is a weaker predictor. SNARE-seq is the clearest counterexample, the fifth best aligned pair of the fourteen at 0.209 0.209 and yet a mutual k k -NN of 0.043 0.043 , lower than pairs that are at chance. The different datasets considered here contain different numbers of samples. Mutual k k -NN measures the overlap of the k k nearest neighbors which is sensitive to the density of the point clouds, and the datasets here differ in size by two orders of magnitude. CKA and TSI compare global similarity structure and are therefore more stable across different sample sizes, which may explain why they predict the alignment better in this setting.
paragraphs.zh: 哪种指标预测效果最好。 在这些领域，CKA 和 TSI 都能追踪对齐情况，而相互 k-k-NN 的预测能力较弱。 SNARE-seq 是最明显的反例：在十四对数据中，这对数据的对齐度排名第五，为 0.209 0.209，但其相互 k-k-NN 值仅为 0.043 0.043，甚至低于随机匹配的样本对。 本文考虑的不同数据集包含的样本数量各不相同。 相互 k-k-NN 衡量的是 k 个最近邻的重叠程度，这一指标对点云密度较为敏感，而本文的数据集在规模上相差两个数量级。 CKA 和 TSI 比较的是全局相似性结构，因此在不同样本规模下更为稳定，这或许能解释为何它们在此设定下能更好地预测对齐情况。

paragraphs.en: When no aligner is needed at all. The pairs above relate modalities that no single encoder covers. We also study the opposite case on five pairs taken from the CycleGAN literature, where one encoder can be applied to both sides, namely MR against CT and CBCT against CT on SynthRAD2023 ( Thummerer et al., 2023 ) , RGB against thermal on LLVIP ( Jia et al., 2021b ) , SAR against optical on SEN12MS-CR ( Ebel et al., 2020 ) and one speaker against another on CMU Arctic ( Kominek & Black, 2004 ) . The four image pairs are embedded with self-supervised vision transformers and the speaker pair with a self-supervised speech model, one encoder per pair as listed in Tab. 11 . Every pair uses the same encoder on both modalities, so the two embedding spaces share a basis by construction and the identity map is a meaningful baseline. We report the identity map, the identity map after subtracting each side’s training mean and normalizing the rows, and our aligner, each over the same five seeds and the same 1024 1024 sample validation slice. Tab. 11 gives the numbers. Our aligner recovers a coarse map on every pair, at 0.020 0.020 for RGB against thermal, 0.054 0.054 for CBCT against CT, 0.217 0.217 for SAR against optical, 0.265 0.265 for the two speakers and 0.253 0.253 for MR against CT, although it uses no identity bias, doesn’t assume the same encoders, and never sees a pair. Centering and normalizing alone is better on four of the five pairs and within 0.001 0.001 on RGB against thermal. On CMU Arctic it recovers the correspondence exactly at 0.000 0.000 because both speakers read the same sentences and one encoder maps them to nearly the same point. This is a stronger statement than the one the rest of the paper makes. Where a single encoder covers both modalities, they can be aligned coarsely across modalities without fitting anything at all. Such an alignment would allow architectures that place a generative model in each space and translate between them without a GAN, in the same way as our text-to-image pipeline in Sec. 4.5 . Our setting is not designed for that use, since we embed one token per image and the map is not pixel-wise by construction, so we leave this direction to future work. The same result also marks the limit of the comparison. When the same model can be used on both sides, centering and normalizing is the method of choice, and our aligner is meant for the pairs where no such model exists, such as vision and language.
paragraphs.zh: 当完全不需要任何对齐器时。 上述配对涉及单个编码器无法覆盖的模态组合。 我们还研究了相反情况，即从 CycleGAN 文献中选取的五组配对，其中一组编码器可用于两侧，具体包括 SynthRAD2023 数据集上的 MR 与 CT、CBCT 与 CT（Thummerer et al., 2023）、LLVIP 数据集上的 RGB 与热成像（Jia et al., 2021b）、SEN12MS-CR 数据集上的 SAR 与光学图像（Ebel et al., 2020），以及 CMU Arctic 数据集上的两名说话者（Kominek & Black, 2004）。 四组图像配对通过自监督视觉变换器进行嵌入，而说话者配对则使用自监督语音模型嵌入，每对配对使用一个编码器，如表 11 所列。 每对配对的两种模态均使用相同的编码器，因此两个嵌入空间在构造上共享同一基矢，恒等映射成为一个有意义的基线。 我们报告了恒等映射、减去每侧训练均值并对行进行归一化后的恒等映射，以及我们的对齐器，所有结果均在相同的五个种子和相同的 1024×1024 样本验证切片上计算得出。 表 11 列出了具体数值。 我们的对齐器在每对配对中都恢复出一个粗略的映射：RGB 与热成像配对的映射为 0.020±0.020，CBCT 与 CT 配对的映射为 0.054±0.054，SAR 与光学图像配对的映射为 0.217±0.217，两名说话者配对的映射为 0.265±0.265，MR 与 CT 配对的映射为 0.253±0.253；尽管该对齐器未使用任何恒等偏置、未假设使用相同的编码器，且从未见过这些配对本身。 仅通过中心化与归一化处理，在五组配对中有四组的性能更优，在 RGB 与热成像配对上的差异也在 0.001±0.001 以内。 在 CMU Arctic 数据集上，该对齐器完全恢复了对应关系，映射值为 0.000±0.000，因为两名说话者朗读的是相同的句子，而一个编码器可将它们映射到几乎相同的点。 这一结论比本文其余部分提出的论断更为强烈。 当单个编码器能够覆盖两种模态时，无需训练任何模型即可在模态间实现粗略对齐。 这种对齐方式使得可以在每个空间中放置一个生成模型，并通过它们之间进行转换，而无需使用 GAN，其原理与第 4.5 节中我们提出的文本到图像流程相同。 我们的设置并非为此用途而设计，因为我们每幅图像仅嵌入一个标记，且该映射在构造上并非像素级的，因此我们将这一方向的研究留给未来的工作。 同一结果也标志着比较的极限。 当同一种模型可用于两侧时，中心化与归一化是最优方法；而我们的对齐器专为不存在此类模型的配对设计，例如视觉与语言模态之间的配对。

sents.zh: 我们的对齐器在每对配对中都恢复出一个粗略的映射：RGB 与热成像配对的映射为 0.020±0.020，CBCT 与 CT 配对的映射为 0.054±0.054，SAR 与光学图像配对的映射为 0.217±0.217，两名说话者配对的映射为 0.265±0.265，MR 与 CT 配对的映射为 0.253±0.253；尽管该对齐器未使用任何恒等偏置、未假设使用相同的编码器，且从未见过这些配对本身。

sents.en: Centering and normalizing alone is better on four of the five pairs and within 0.001 0.001 on RGB against thermal.
sents.zh: 仅通过中心化与归一化处理，在五组配对中有四组的性能更优，在 RGB 与热成像配对上的差异也在 0.001±0.001 以内。

sents.en: On CMU Arctic it recovers the correspondence exactly at 0.000 0.000 because both speakers read the same sentences and one encoder maps them to nearly the same point.
sents.zh: 在 CMU Arctic 数据集上，该对齐器完全恢复了对应关系，映射值为 0.000±0.000，因为两名说话者朗读的是相同的句子，而一个编码器可将它们映射到几乎相同的点。

sents.en: This is a stronger statement than the one the rest of the paper makes.
sents.zh: 这一结论比本文其余部分提出的论断更为强烈。

sents.en: Where a single encoder covers both modalities, they can be aligned coarsely across modalities without fitting anything at all.
sents.zh: 当单个编码器能够覆盖两种模态时，无需训练任何模型即可在模态间实现粗略对齐。

sents.en: Such an alignment would allow architectures that place a generative model in each space and translate between them without a GAN, in the same way as our text-to-image pipeline in Sec. 4.5 .
sents.zh: 这种对齐方式使得可以在每个空间中放置一个生成模型，并通过它们之间进行转换，而无需使用 GAN，其原理与第 4.5 节中我们提出的文本到图像流程相同。

sents.en: Our setting is not designed for that use, since we embed one token per image and the map is not pixel-wise by construction, so we leave this direction to future work.
sents.zh: 我们的设置并非为此用途而设计，因为我们每幅图像仅嵌入一个标记，且该映射在构造上并非像素级的，因此我们将这一方向的研究留给未来的工作。

sents.en: The same result also marks the limit of the comparison.
sents.zh: 同一结果也标志着比较的极限。

sents.en: When the same model can be used on both sides, centering and normalizing is the method of choice, and our aligner is meant for the pairs where no such model exists, such as vision and language.
sents.zh: 当同一种模型可用于两侧时，中心化与归一化是最优方法；而我们的对齐器专为不存在此类模型的配对设计，例如视觉与语言模态之间的配对。

paragraphs.en: On MS COCO, Qwen3-8B with generative token pooling is competitive with the two embedding models and is the best of the three for DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Fig. 9 ). On the detailed captioning corpora, it is the worst of the three for every vision model. This appendix explores the reason. Generative token pooling asks the language model to write a description of what the text would look like and pools the tokens it generates, rather than the tokens of the caption itself ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Our hypothesis is that generation adds visual detail that a short caption leaves out but cannot add much to a long caption that already contains it.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MS COCO 数据集上，采用生成式词元池化的 Qwen3-8B 与两种嵌入模型具有竞争力，并且在 DINOv2 ViT-B/14 任务中是三者中的最佳模型（图 9）。 在详细的图像描述语料库中，对于每一种视觉模型，它都是三者中最差的。 本附录将探讨其背后的原因。 生成式词元池化要求语言模型编写一段描述文本应呈现为何种样式的文字，并对生成的词元进行池化处理，而不是使用图像描述本身的词元（Wang 等，2026）。 我们的假设是：生成过程会补充短描述所遗漏的视觉细节，但对于已经包含这些细节的长描述而言，则无法增添太多新内容。

sents.en: On MS COCO, Qwen3-8B with generative token pooling is competitive with the two embedding models and is the best of the three for DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Fig. 9 ).
sents.zh: 在 MS COCO 数据集上，采用生成式词元池化的 Qwen3-8B 与两种嵌入模型具有竞争力，并且在 DINOv2 ViT-B/14 任务中是三者中的最佳模型（图 9）。

sents.en: On the detailed captioning corpora, it is the worst of the three for every vision model.
sents.zh: 在详细的图像描述语料库中，对于每一种视觉模型，它都是三者中最差的。

sents.en: This appendix explores the reason.
sents.zh: 本附录将探讨其背后的原因。

sents.en: Generative token pooling asks the language model to write a description of what the text would look like and pools the tokens it generates, rather than the tokens of the caption itself ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 生成式词元池化要求语言模型编写一段描述文本应呈现为何种样式的文字，并对生成的词元进行池化处理，而不是使用图像描述本身的词元（Wang 等，2026）。

sents.en: Our hypothesis is that generation adds visual detail that a short caption leaves out but cannot add much to a long caption that already contains it.
sents.zh: 我们的假设是：生成过程会补充短描述所遗漏的视觉细节，但对于已经包含这些细节的长描述而言，则无法增添太多新内容。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We compare three poolings of the same captions against the same DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) image embeddings. Generative pooling prompts Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with Imagine what it would look like to see: followed by the caption and averages the hidden states of at most 128 128 generated tokens. Mean pooling averages the hidden states of the caption tokens with the same backbone and no prompt, which isolates the effect of generating. Embedding pooling uses Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and serves as a reference point. We evaluate the alignment on six datasets with varying caption lengths. MS COCO ( Chen et al., 2015 ) at 11.9 11.9 Qwen3 tokens on average, CC12M ( Changpinyo et al., 2021 ) at 24.8 24.8 , WIT ( Srinivasan et al., 2021 ) at 41.5 41.5 , Stanford Paragraph Captioning ( Krause et al., 2017 ) at 53.8 53.8 , DOCCI ( Onoe et al., 2024 ) at 140.8 140.8 and Densely Captioned Images ( Urbanek et al., 2024 ) at 167.0 167.0 . Each score is measured on five disjoint slices of 1024 1024 pairs. We report the clipped CKA of Wang et al. (2026) , which clips every feature at the mean 95 95 th percentile of its absolute value and normalizes rows without centering them. The main goal of this experiment is to isolate in which settings generative token pooling can help. Instead of comparing the absolute level of each pooling, we compare the difference between different embedding strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们将三种对相同图像说明文本的池化方法，与相同的 DINOv2 ViT-B/14（Oquab 等人，2024）图像嵌入进行比较。 生成式池化通过提示 Qwen3-8B（Yang 等人，2025）使用“想象一下它会是什么样子：”这一短语，随后输入图像说明文本，并对最多 128 个生成的标记的隐藏状态求平均。 均值池化则对图像说明文本标记的隐藏状态与相同主干网络且无提示的情况进行平均，从而隔离了生成过程的影响。 嵌入池化使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B（Zhang 等人，2025），并作为参考基准。 我们在六个具有不同图像说明文本长度的数据集上评估了这种对齐效果。 MS COCO（Chen 等人，2015）的平均 Qwen3 标记数为 11.9，CC12M（Changpinyo 等人，2021）为 24.8，WIT（Srinivasan 等人，2021）为 41.5，Stanford Paragraph Captioning（Krause 等人，2017）为 53.8，DOCCI（Onoe 等人，2024）为 140.8，以及 Densely Captioned Images（Urbanek 等人，2024）为 167.0。 每个分数均基于 1024 对图像说明文本的五个互不重叠的切片进行测量。 我们报告了 Wang 等人（2026）提出的截断 CKA 值。 该方法将每个特征值截断至其绝对值的第 95 百分位数的均值，并对行进行归一化，但不对行进行中心化处理。 本实验的主要目标是确定在哪些情况下生成式标记池化能够发挥作用。 我们并未比较每种池化方法的绝对水平，而是比较了不同嵌入策略之间的差异。

The difference of generative and mean pooling is positive on the three corpora with short or web-scraped captions, + 0.099 +0.099 on MS COCO, + 0.107 +0.107 on CC12M and + 0.211 +0.211 on WIT, near zero on the paragraph corpus at + 0.014 +0.014 , and negative on the two densest, − 0.144 -0.144 on DOCCI and − 0.067 -0.067 on DCI.

paragraphs.en: Cross-modal alignment appears to depend on the scale at which it is measured. Gröger et al. (2026a) show that, after accounting for model depth and width, convergence is mainly expressed through local neighborhood structure rather than global distances. However, they mainly focus on the convergence with increasing model and dataset size and not on the absolute values. Koepke et al. (2026) show that for fixed k k , mutual k k -NN degrades substantially when the dataset is scaled to millions of samples, whereas the alignment is stable at a fixed ratio of k = n / 100 k=n/100 . At large scales and for a fixed k k , the alignment is much weaker than the alignment between language models, but remains above the random baseline. Thus, their results show that fine-grained vision-language alignment is limited, while some coarser alignment remains. Concurrent to our work, You et al. (2026) introduce a global counterpart to mutual k k -NN based on minimum spanning tree (MST) edge overlap. Their analysis separates local vs. global scale from relational structure vs. metric geometry. They find models converge both in local and global relational structure, but a weaker convergence when distance agreement is required.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模态对齐似乎取决于其测量尺度。Gröger 等人（2026a）指出，在考虑了模型深度和宽度之后，收敛性主要通过局部邻域结构体现，而非全局距离。然而，他们主要关注模型和数据集规模增大时的收敛性，而非绝对值。Koepke 等人（2026）的研究表明，对于固定的 k，当数据集规模扩大至数百万样本时，相互 k-NN 的性能会显著下降，而在固定比例 k = n / 100 的情况下，对齐则保持稳定。在大规模数据中且 k 固定时，这种对齐弱于语言模型之间的对齐，但仍高于随机基线。因此，他们的研究结果表明，精细的视觉-语言对齐存在局限性，但某些较粗的对齐仍然存在。与我们工作同时期，You 等人（2026）提出了一种基于最小生成树（MST）边重叠的全局相互 k-NN 方法。他们的分析将局部与全局尺度、关系结构与度量几何区分开来。他们发现，模型在局部和全局关系结构上均表现出收敛性，但在需要距离一致性的情况下，这种收敛性较弱。

paragraphs.en: However, these experiments do not directly compare different levels of granularity under the same evaluation conditions. Changing the sample count and k k changes the granularity of the mutual k k -NN comparison, making the resulting alignment values difficult to compare directly across scales. In this section, we want to test at which levels of granularity alignment exists and how strong it is when the evaluation conditions are held comparable. We study this in three complementary experiments:
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些实验并未在相同的评估条件下直接比较不同精细程度的水平。 改变样本数量以及 k 值会改变相互 k-NN 比较的精细程度，导致所得对齐值在不同尺度之间难以直接比较。 在本节中，我们希望测试在保持评估条件具有可比性的情况下，对齐现象存在于哪些精细程度水平，以及其强度如何。 我们通过三个相互补充的实验来研究这一问题：

sents.zh: 然而，这些实验并未在相同的评估条件下直接比较不同精细程度的水平。

sents.en: Changing the sample count and k k changes the granularity of the mutual k k -NN comparison, making the resulting alignment values difficult to compare directly across scales.
sents.zh: 改变样本数量以及 k 值会改变相互 k-NN 比较的精细程度，导致所得对齐值在不同尺度之间难以直接比较。

sents.en: In this section, we want to test at which levels of granularity alignment exists and how strong it is when the evaluation conditions are held comparable.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们希望测试在保持评估条件具有可比性的情况下，对齐现象存在于哪些精细程度水平，以及其强度如何。

sents.en: We study this in three complementary experiments:
sents.zh: 我们通过三个相互补充的实验来研究这一问题：

paragraphs.en: A clustering-based experiment, where we can compare the alignment over cluster centers with the alignment within each cluster. We find that the alignment is substantially stronger across the cluster centers compared to inside individual clusters.
paragraphs.zh: 一项基于聚类的实验，其中我们可以比较聚类中心之间的对齐情况与每个聚类内部的对齐情况。 我们发现，聚类中心之间的对齐程度明显强于各个聚类内部的对齐程度。

sents.en: A clustering-based experiment, where we can compare the alignment over cluster centers with the alignment within each cluster.
sents.zh: 一项基于聚类的实验，其中我们可以比较聚类中心之间的对齐情况与每个聚类内部的对齐情况。

sents.en: We find that the alignment is substantially stronger across the cluster centers compared to inside individual clusters.
sents.zh: 我们发现，聚类中心之间的对齐程度明显强于各个聚类内部的对齐程度。

paragraphs.en: A PCA-based experiment, where we evaluate how much of the alignment is captured by a small number of dominant dimensions. Most of the observed alignment is already captured by the first ten PCA dimensions. Random subspaces require substantially more dimensions to reach comparable alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 一项基于主成分分析（PCA）的实验，我们评估少量主导维度能够捕捉多少对齐信息。 观察到的大部分对齐信息已经由前十个主成分分析维度所捕捉。 随机子空间需要更多维度才能达到相当的对齐效果。

sents.zh: 一项基于主成分分析（PCA）的实验，我们评估少量主导维度能够捕捉多少对齐信息。

paragraphs.en: A clipping-based experiment, where one cosine similarity kernel is clipped from below or above and the alignment is evaluated after clipping. This neglects the structure outside the clipping threshold and evaluates the impact of this structure on the general alignment. We find that cosine similarity values between 0.0 0.0 and 0.6 0.6 contribute most strongly to the alignment. Very close points and far points don’t share as much structure.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于裁剪的实验：其中一个余弦相似度核函数从下方或上方进行裁剪，并在裁剪后评估对齐效果。 这种方法忽略了裁剪阈值之外的结构，并评估了该结构对整体对齐的影响。 我们发现，介于 0.0 0.0 和 0.6 0.6 之间的余弦相似度值对对齐的贡献最大。 非常接近的点和相距较远的点所共享的结构较少。

sents.zh: 一种基于裁剪的实验：其中一个余弦相似度核函数从下方或上方进行裁剪，并在裁剪后评估对齐效果。

sents.en: We find that cosine similarity values between 0.0 0.0 and 0.6 0.6 contribute most strongly to the alignment.
sents.zh: 我们发现，介于 0.0 0.0 和 0.6 0.6 之间的余弦相似度值对对齐的贡献最大。

sents.en: Very close points and far points don’t share as much structure.
sents.zh: 非常接近的点和相距较远的点所共享的结构较少。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate all experiments with DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , two language models (MPNet ( Reimers & Gurevych, 2019 ) , Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ), and two datasets (MS COCO ( Chen et al., 2015 ) and WIT ( Srinivasan et al., 2021 ) ). We measure alignment with four alignment measures: CKA ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , mutual k k -NN with k = max ⁡ ( 1 , ⌊ n / 100 ⌋ ) k=\max(1,\lfloor n/100\rfloor) ( Huh et al., 2024 ) , TSI, and QSI ( Soares et al., 2026 ) . We repeat every experiment for 10 random seeds and report the mean and standard deviation.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们使用 DINOv2 ViT-B/14（Oquab 等人，2024）、两种语言模型（MPNet（Reimers & Gurevych，2019）、Qwen3-Embedding-8B（Zhang 等人，2025））以及两个数据集（MS COCO（Chen 等人，2015）和 WIT（Srinivasan 等人，2021））来评估所有实验。 我们使用四种对齐度量来衡量对齐程度：CKA（Kornblith 等人，2019）、互 k-k-NN（其中 k = max(1, ⌊n/100⌋)）（Huh 等人，2024）、TSI 和 QSI（Soares 等人，2026）。 我们对每个实验重复 10 次随机种子实验，并报告平均值和标准差。

sents.en: Setup.
sents.zh: 设置。

sents.en: We evaluate all experiments with DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , two language models (MPNet ( Reimers & Gurevych, 2019 ) , Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ), and two datasets (MS COCO ( Chen et al., 2015 ) and WIT ( Srinivasan et al., 2021 ) ).
sents.zh: 我们使用 DINOv2 ViT-B/14（Oquab 等人，2024）、两种语言模型（MPNet（Reimers & Gurevych，2019）、Qwen3-Embedding-8B（Zhang 等人，2025））以及两个数据集（MS COCO（Chen 等人，2015）和 WIT（Srinivasan 等人，2021））来评估所有实验。

sents.en: We measure alignment with four alignment measures: CKA ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , mutual k k -NN with k = max ⁡ ( 1 , ⌊ n / 100 ⌋ ) k=\max(1,\lfloor n/100\rfloor) ( Huh et al., 2024 ) , TSI, and QSI ( Soares et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用四种对齐度量来衡量对齐程度：CKA（Kornblith 等人，2019）、互 k-k-NN（其中 k = max(1, ⌊n/100⌋)）（Huh 等人，2024）、TSI 和 QSI（Soares 等人，2026）。

sents.en: We repeat every experiment for 10 random seeds and report the mean and standard deviation.
sents.zh: 我们对每个实验重复 10 次随机种子实验，并报告平均值和标准差。

paragraphs.en: Cluster-based experiment ( Fig. 22 ). We first test whether coarse groups are more strongly aligned than the fine-grained structure within those groups. We jointly cluster the two representation spaces using size-balanced k k -means on at most 100,000 points and lift the clustering to the full dataset for MS COCO and to 500,000 random samples for WIT. For each granularity, we sample the same number of points from each cluster and compare alignment across cluster centers, within clusters, and on a random subset of the same size.
paragraphs.zh: 基于聚类的实验（图 22）。 我们首先测试粗粒度分组是否比这些分组内部的细粒度结构具有更强的对齐性。 我们对两个表示空间进行联合聚类，使用大小平衡的 k-k 均值算法处理最多 100,000 个点，然后将该聚类结果扩展到 MS COCO 的完整数据集，以及 WIT 的 500,000 个随机样本。 对于每种粒度，我们从每个聚类中采样相同数量的点，并比较聚类中心之间、聚类内部以及相同大小的随机子集上的对齐情况。

sents.en: Cluster-based experiment ( Fig. 22 ).
sents.zh: 基于聚类的实验（图 22）。

sents.en: We first test whether coarse groups are more strongly aligned than the fine-grained structure within those groups.
sents.zh: 我们首先测试粗粒度分组是否比这些分组内部的细粒度结构具有更强的对齐性。

sents.en: We jointly cluster the two representation spaces using size-balanced k k -means on at most 100,000 points and lift the clustering to the full dataset for MS COCO and to 500,000 random samples for WIT.
sents.zh: 我们对两个表示空间进行联合聚类，使用大小平衡的 k-k 均值算法处理最多 100,000 个点，然后将该聚类结果扩展到 MS COCO 的完整数据集，以及 WIT 的 500,000 个随机样本。

sents.en: For each granularity, we sample the same number of points from each cluster and compare alignment across cluster centers, within clusters, and on a random subset of the same size.
sents.zh: 对于每种粒度，我们从每个聚类中采样相同数量的点，并比较聚类中心之间、聚类内部以及相同大小的随机子集上的对齐情况。

paragraphs.en: Across datasets, models, and granularities, alignment across cluster centers is substantially stronger than alignment within individual clusters. Random sampling is usually closer to the fine alignment. This shows that the modalities agree more strongly on coarse organization than on fine-grained structure.
paragraphs.zh: 在不同数据集、模型和粒度层面，跨簇中心的对齐程度显著强于单个簇内部的对齐程度。 随机采样通常更接近精细对齐。 这表明，模态在粗粒度组织上的共识比在细粒度结构上更强。

sents.en: Across datasets, models, and granularities, alignment across cluster centers is substantially stronger than alignment within individual clusters.
sents.zh: 在不同数据集、模型和粒度层面，跨簇中心的对齐程度显著强于单个簇内部的对齐程度。

sents.en: Random sampling is usually closer to the fine alignment.
sents.zh: 随机采样通常更接近精细对齐。

sents.en: This shows that the modalities agree more strongly on coarse organization than on fine-grained structure.
sents.zh: 这表明，模态在粗粒度组织上的共识比在细粒度结构上更强。

paragraphs.en: PCA-based experiment ( Fig. 23 ). We next examine whether the shared alignment is concentrated in a small number of dominant dimensions. We subsample 10,000 points and project each representation space onto its first p p principal components. We compare this to random subspaces of the same dimensionality.
paragraphs.zh: 基于主成分分析的实验（图23）。 接下来，我们检验共享对齐是否集中在少数几个主导维度中。 我们对10,000个点进行子采样，并将每个表示空间投影到其前p个主成分上。 我们将此结果与相同维度的随机子空间进行比较。

sents.en: PCA-based experiment ( Fig. 23 ).
sents.zh: 基于主成分分析的实验（图23）。

sents.en: We next examine whether the shared alignment is concentrated in a small number of dominant dimensions.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们检验共享对齐是否集中在少数几个主导维度中。

sents.en: We subsample 10,000 points and project each representation space onto its first p p principal components.
sents.zh: 我们对10,000个点进行子采样，并将每个表示空间投影到其前p个主成分上。

sents.en: We compare this to random subspaces of the same dimensionality.
sents.zh: 我们将此结果与相同维度的随机子空间进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The first ten PCA dimensions already capture most of the observed alignment across datasets, models, and alignment measures. In some cases, they even produce slightly higher alignment than using more dimensions. The only exception is mutual k k -NN, which needs an order of magnitude more components. Random projections require substantially more dimensions to reach comparable alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 前十个主成分分析（PCA）维度已经捕捉到了跨数据集、模型和对齐度指标的大部分观察到的对齐情况。 在某些情况下，它们甚至能产生比使用更多维度略高的对齐度。 唯一的例外是相互 k-k-NN 方法，它需要多一个数量级的组件。 随机投影需要多得多的维度才能达到相当的对齐度。

sents.en: The first ten PCA dimensions already capture most of the observed alignment across datasets, models, and alignment measures.
sents.zh: 前十个主成分分析（PCA）维度已经捕捉到了跨数据集、模型和对齐度指标的大部分观察到的对齐情况。

sents.en: In some cases, they even produce slightly higher alignment than using more dimensions.
sents.zh: 在某些情况下，它们甚至能产生比使用更多维度略高的对齐度。

sents.en: The only exception is mutual k k -NN, which needs an order of magnitude more components.
sents.zh: 唯一的例外是相互 k-k-NN 方法，它需要多一个数量级的组件。

sents.en: Random projections require substantially more dimensions to reach comparable alignment.
sents.zh: 随机投影需要多得多的维度才能达到相当的对齐度。

paragraphs.en: Clipping-based experiment ( Fig. 24 ). Finally, we test which ranges of cosine similarity contribute most to the alignment. We clip a cosine-similarity kernel from below or above and measure alignment after clipping on subsets of 10,000 10{,}000 points.
paragraphs.zh: 基于裁剪的实验（图 24）。 最后，我们测试余弦相似性的哪些范围对对齐贡献最大。 我们从下方或上方裁剪余弦相似性核，并在 10,000 个点的子集上进行裁剪后测量对齐效果。

sents.en: Clipping-based experiment ( Fig. 24 ).
sents.zh: 基于裁剪的实验（图 24）。

sents.en: Finally, we test which ranges of cosine similarity contribute most to the alignment.
sents.zh: 最后，我们测试余弦相似性的哪些范围对对齐贡献最大。

sents.en: We clip a cosine-similarity kernel from below or above and measure alignment after clipping on subsets of 10,000 10{,}000 points.
sents.zh: 我们从下方或上方裁剪余弦相似性核，并在 10,000 个点的子集上进行裁剪后测量对齐效果。

paragraphs.en: We find that cosine similarities between 0.0 0.0 and 0.6 0.6 carry most of the alignment. The structure outside this range is largely redundant. Clipping similarities above 0.6 0.6 has only a limited effect, indicating that the precise structure of very close points is not strongly shared. Similarly, moving all negative cosine similarities to zero has little effect on CKA and mutual k k -NN, suggesting that the precise structure of very distant points contributes little.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，0.0 0.0 和 0.6 0.6 之间的余弦相似度承载了大部分对齐信息。 该范围之外的结构在很大程度上是冗余的。 将高于 0.6 0.6 的相似度截断仅产生有限影响，这表明非常接近的点之间的精确结构并未被强烈共享。 类似地，将所有负余弦相似度设为零对 CKA 和相互 k k -NN 几乎没有影响，这表明非常遥远的点之间的精确结构贡献甚微。

sents.en: We find that cosine similarities between 0.0 0.0 and 0.6 0.6 carry most of the alignment.
sents.zh: 我们发现，0.0 0.0 和 0.6 0.6 之间的余弦相似度承载了大部分对齐信息。

sents.en: The structure outside this range is largely redundant.
sents.zh: 该范围之外的结构在很大程度上是冗余的。

sents.en: Clipping similarities above 0.6 0.6 has only a limited effect, indicating that the precise structure of very close points is not strongly shared.
sents.zh: 将高于 0.6 0.6 的相似度截断仅产生有限影响，这表明非常接近的点之间的精确结构并未被强烈共享。

sents.en: Similarly, moving all negative cosine similarities to zero has little effect on CKA and mutual k k -NN, suggesting that the precise structure of very distant points contributes little.
sents.zh: 类似地，将所有负余弦相似度设为零对 CKA 和相互 k k -NN 几乎没有影响，这表明非常遥远的点之间的精确结构贡献甚微。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the strongest shared structure lies at an intermediate, coarse similarity scale. The modalities share coarse relationships between samples, and the structure of very close and very distant points adds little beyond them.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，最强的共享结构存在于中等、粗略的相似性尺度上。 这些模态在样本之间共享粗略的关系，而非常接近和非常遥远的点所构成的结构并未带来太多额外信息。

sents.en: Overall, the strongest shared structure lies at an intermediate, coarse similarity scale.
sents.zh: 总体而言，最强的共享结构存在于中等、粗略的相似性尺度上。

sents.en: The modalities share coarse relationships between samples, and the structure of very close and very distant points adds little beyond them.
sents.zh: 这些模态在样本之间共享粗略的关系，而非常接近和非常遥远的点所构成的结构并未带来太多额外信息。
